ar.name: باب الخليل.
description:
باب الخليل هو الباب الوحيد الذي يستقبل القادمين إلى مدينة القدس القديمة من الغرب والجنوب. لذلك، سُمِّي باسمي مدينتي الخليل ويافا الواقعتين غرب وجنوب هذا الباب. ويقابل باب الخليل - وإن كان ليس تماماً - باب الأسباط الذي يقع في الجدار الشرقي لمدينة القدس القديمة.  
وباب الخليل كتلة معمارية تشبه البرج البارز عن سمت السور. وهو ذو تخطيط مربع، ويحتوي على ممر يأخذ شكل حرف "L" اللاتيني مكوناً باباً منكسراً يضطر الداخل أو الخارج منه إلى تغيير اتجاه مروره بزاوية 90 درجة. وهو في هذا التخطيط يشبه تخطيط بقية أبواب سور القدس وأبواب العصور الوسطى المملوكية والعثمانية. ويمكن الوصول إلى داخل الباب عبر باب فُتِح في الواجهة الشمالية يوصل إلى دركاه فُتِح في جدارها الغربي كوَّة تنتهي بفتحة مزغل. وثبتت لوحة كتابية في وسط الواجهة الجنوبية تستقبل الداخل وتسجّل اسم السلطان العثماني سليمان القانوني كبانٍ لسور القدس. ويبلغ طول اللوحة 120 سم وعرضها 60 سم، وعدد أسطرها ثلاثة يفصلها عن بعضها البعض خراطيش بسيطة. ونص اللوحة كما يلي:  
"أمر بإنشاء هذه السور المبارك مولانا سلطان الأعظم والخاقان المكرم مالك رقاب الأمم  
سلطان الروم والعرب والعجم في البرين والبحرين السلطان سليمان بن سليم خان  
خلد الله ملكه وسلطانه بتاريخ شهر جمادى الأول من شهور سنة خمس وأربعين وتسعماية."  
  
لباب الخليل أربع واجهات، ثلاث منها خارجية: الشمالية والغربية والجنوبية. يمكن للناظر إلى السور الغربي للمدينة من الخارج أن يرى هذه الواجهات بوضوح. أما الواجهة الرابعة (الشرقية) فهي التي تظهر من داخل المدينة. والواجهتان الجنوبية والغربية مصمتتان، بُنيتا من صفوف من الحجارة المهذبة. وقد فُتِح مزغل في وسط الواجهة الغربية، على مستوى المدماك التاسع عشر. وتقوم على جانبي هذا المزغل وفي أعلاه حشوة دائرية بارزة على شكل قرص.  
وتتكون الواجهة الشمالية لباب الخليل التي يتم الدخول إلى المدينة عبرها من فتحة باب واسعة متراجعة تنتهي بعقد تخفيف. ويقع فوق العقد مباشرة لوحة كتابية نقشت بخط النسخ العثماني يبلغ طولها 100 سم وعرضها 60 سم. ونص اللوحة التي تتكون من أربعة أسطر كما يلي:  
"بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم  
أمر بإنشاء هذا السور المبارك  
مولانا سلطان الأعظم مالك الروم والعرب والعجم  
سلطان سليمان بن سليم خان خلد الله ملكه في تاريخ سنة 945."  
ويحيط بفتحة الباب حنية يعلوها عقد مدبب يدور حول صنجه زخرفة قالبية. تنتهي الزخرفة عند كل من جانبي العقد بلوحة دائرية ناتئة على شكل قرص حُفر فيها زخارف نباتية وهندسية. ويوجد على ارتفاع مدماك من مفتاح العقد المدبب فص حجري، وتقع فوقه مباشرة ثلاثة كوابيل حجرية تحمل شرفة صماء. وفُتِح في هذه الواجهة مزغلان لرمي السهام وللمراقبة. وتشبه واجهة باب الخليل الشرقية التي تطل على داخل المدينة الواجهة الشمالية للباب.

الباب الوحيد الذي يُفتح في السور الغربي للقدس، والذي أمر ببنائه السلطان سليمان القانوني، ضمن مشروعه الضخم لإعادة بناء أسوار المدينة وبواباتها. وقاعتا الباب متعامدتان بزاوية قائمة، وذلك لأغراض دفاعية، وثُبتت لوحة كتابية في وسط الواجهة الجنوبية، تسجّل اسم السلطان، باعتباره من بنى الباب وسور القدس. وللباب مكوِّنات أخرى، هدفها تسهيل الدفاع عنه.
artist: السلطان العثماني سليمان القانوني (حكم في الفترة 926 - 974 / 1520- 1566).
يُرجَّح أن فريقاً من معمارين محليين ووافدين من مدينة حلب قام ببناء الباب، حيث يرد في سجلات محكمة القدس الشرعية ألقاب لبعض المعمارين المقدسيين والحلبيين ممن عملوا في مشروع سور القدس .
keywords: باب؛ باب الخليل؛ سور القدس؛ عمارة عسكرية.

en.name: Bab al-Khalil (Gate of Hebron).
description:
The Bab al-Khalil (Gate of Hebron) is the only gate that receives visitors into the city of Jerusalem from both the south and the west. It is for this reason that the gate was given two names: Bab Hebron (al-Khalil) and Bab Yaffa (Jaffa), as they are two cities located to the south and west of the gate. Roughly facing Bab al-Khalil is Bab al-Asbat (the Lion's Gate), located in the east wall of the old city of Jerusalem.  
Due to the architectural bulk of Bab al-Khalil it resembles a tower projecting from the fortified walls. The gate is square in design and contains an L-shaped passageway whereby the orientation of both the interior and exterior are forced to change direction by an angle of 90 degrees. This layout is reminiscent of other gates in the walls of Jerusalem and similar gates of the Middle Ages, specifically those of the Mamluk and Ottoman periods.  
The interior of the gate is accessed by an entrance on the north side of the wall. The entrance leads into a vestibule, on the west wall of which is an aperture with an embrasure opening. An inscription panel hangs in the middle of the south side of the vestibule, recording the name of the Ottoman Sultan, Sulayman the Magnificent as patron of the fortifications.  
The northern side of Bab al-Khalil leads into the city by means of a wide receding portal that ends with a supporting arch. Directly above the arch is an inscription panel carved in Ottoman *naskhi* script:  
“In the Name of the God, the Most Gracious and the Most Merciful,  
The order for the construction of these blessed walls was made by our master, the Sultan the Great, The Sovereign, The Ruler of Rome, Arabs and Persians, Sultan Sulayman bin Selim Khan. May God prolong his reign and power in the year AH 945 \[AD 1538\].”  
The portal is flanked by a recess, above which is a tapered arch. Around the voussoirs of the arch there is stamped decoration. The decoration ends either side of the arch with a projecting panel in the form of a medallion carved with vegetal and geometric motifs. At the height of one stone course from the keystone of the arch there is a stone lobe. Directly above it are three stone corbels, which bear a machicolation. Opening out of this façade, is an embrasure for shooting arrows as well as serving as an observation point. The eastern façade of Bab al-Khalil, which overlooks the interior of the city, resembles the northern façade of the gate.

This is the only gate which opens onto the Western Wall of Jerusalem. Its construction was ordered by Sultan Sulayman the Magnificent as part of his great project to restore the walls of the city and its gates. For defence purposes the two vestibules of the gate are at right angles to each other, meeting at a sharp corner. An inscription panel is set in the middle of the southern façade which records the name of the sultan as the builder of the gate and the walls of Jerusalem. The gate also has other elements whose aim is to facilitate its defence.
artist: The Ottoman sultan, Sulayman the Magnificent (r. AH 926–74 / AD 1520–66).

It is probable that a team of local architects and delegates from the city of Aleppo were responsible for the construction of the gate. The registers of the Shari’a Court in Jerusalem have recorded the names of some of the architects from Jerusalem and Aleppo who worked on the fortifications of Jerusalem.
keywords: Gate; fortifications; military architecture

es.name: Bab al-Jalil (puerta de Hebrón).
description:
La Bab al-Jalil (puerta de Hebrón) es la única puerta de Jerusalén que recibe transeúntes o viajeros desde el sur y el este. Eso explica que se llame Bab Yaffa y Bab al-Jalil, que son las ciudades que quedan al sur y al este de la puerta. Casi en frente de la Bab al-Jalil está la Bab al-Asbat (puerta del León), ubicada en el este de la muralla del Jerusalén viejo.  
Por su estructura, la Bab al-Jalil parece una torre que sobresale de la muralla. Es cuadrada y consta de un pasaje en forma de L que modifica en 90 grados la orientación tanto desde el interior como desde el exterior. Esta disposición recuerda a otras puertas de la muralla de Jerusalén y otras puertas medievales, concretamente a las de los periodos mameluco y otomano. Al interior de la puerta se accede por una entrada situada en el lado norte de la muralla. Esta entrada conduce a un vestíbulo con una saetera en la pared oeste. En el centro del muro sur hay una inscripción con el nombre del patrocinador de las fortificaciones, el sultán otomano Suleyman el Magnífico.  
El lado norte de Bab al-Jalil brinda acceso a la ciudad por medio de un portal rehundido rematado con un arco. Justo encima del arco hay un panel con una inscripción tallada en escritura *nasji* otomana que dice así:  
”En el nombre de Dios, el piadoso, el compasivo. La orden de construir esta bendita muralla vino de nuestro dueño, el gran sultán, el soberano, el gobernante de Roma \[Bizancio\], los árabes y persas, el sultán Suleyman ibn Selim Jan. ¡Que Dios prolongue su reinado y su poder! En el año 945 \[1538\]”.  
El portal está flanqueando por una zona rehundida bajo un arco apuntado. Alrededor de las dovelas del arco presenta una moldura que termina a cada lado con un medallón de motivos vegetales y geométricos tallados. Una hilada de sillares por encima de la clave del arco hay un lóbulo de piedra. Encima tiene tres ménsulas con un matacán. La fachada presenta saeteras para disparar flechas o vigilar. La fachada este de la Bab al-Jalil, que da al interior de la ciudad, se parece a la fachada norte.

Esta es la única puerta que se abre en el muro occidental de Jerusalén. Se construyó por orden del sultán Suleyman el Magnífico dentro de su gran proyecto de restauración de las murallas y puertas de la ciudad. Dada su función defensiva, los dos vestíbulos de la puerta forman un ángulo recto. La puerta presenta otros elementos defensivos. En el centro de la fachada sur hay una lápida con una inscripción que menciona al sultán como patrocinador de la puerta y las murallas de la ciudad.
artist: El sultán otomano Suleyman el Magnífico (r. 926-974 / 1520-1566).

Probablemente un grupo de arquitectos locales y de la ciudad de Alepo. En los archivos del Tribunal de la Sharia de Jerusalén se conservan los nombres de varios arquitectos de Jerusalén y Alepo que trabajaron en la fortificación de Jerusalén.
keywords: Puerta; fortificaciones; arquitectura militar.

fr.name: Bab al-Khalil.
description:
Bab al-Khalil (porte d'Hébron) est la seule porte de Jérusalem à laquelle aboutissaient deux routes, l'une venant du sud, l'autre de l'ouest. C'est la raison pour laquelle cet ensemble porte deux noms : Bab Hebron (al-Khalil) et Bab Yaffa (Jaffa). Il fait face à la porte du Lion (Bab al-Asbat), située dans le mur oriental de la vieille ville.  
Le plan évoque celui d'une tour qui serait implantée en avant des remparts. L'ensemble de plan carré recouvre un passage en L, selon une disposition qui rappelle d'autres entrées de Jérusalem et certaines de l'époque médiévale, en particulier des périodes mamelouke et ottomane.  
On accède à l'intérieur de la construction par une entrée ouverte dans le côté nord de la muraille, qui donne sur un vestibule dans lequel s'ouvre, à l'ouest, une baie à embrasure. Un panneau épigraphié scellé au centre du mur sud mentionne le nom du sultan ottoman Soliman le Magnifique, commanditaire de ces fortifications.  
On pénètre dans la ville par le nord de la porte au moyen d'un large portail en retrait surmonté d'un arc au-dessus duquel un panneau épigraphié sculpté en style *naskhi* ottoman dit : “Au nom de Dieu, le plus Clément, le plus Miséricordieux, l'ordre de construire ces murailles bénies a été donné par notre maître, le Sultan, le Grand, le Souverain, le Maître de Rome, des Arabes et des Perses, le Sultan Soliman bin Selim Khan. Que Dieu prolonge son règne et son pouvoir en l'an 945 \[1538 J.-C.\].”  
L'entrée se trouve dans une niche surmontée d'un arc brisé flanqué de deux médaillons en relief à décor végétal et géométrique. A hauteur d'une rangée de pierres de la clé de voûte se trouve un lobe de pierre surmonté d'une bretèche à meurtrière, reposant sur trois corbeaux, qui pouvait servait de guet. La façade orientale de la Bab al-Khalil qui donne sur la vieille ville est similaire à la façade nord.

Bab al-Khalil est la seule porte qui ouvre sur le mur occidental de Jérusalem. Sa construction fut ordonnée par le sultan Soliman le Magnifique dans le cadre de son grand projet de restaurer les murs et les portes de la ville. Pour des raisons défensives, les deux vestibules de la porte sont situés à angles droits l’un de l’autre, se rencontrant en angle aigu. Un panneau d’inscription scellé au milieu de la façade sud mentionne le nom du sultan comme le commanditaire de la porte et des murs de Jérusalem. La porte présente également d’autres éléments destinés à faciliter sa défense.
artist: Le sultan ottoman Soliman le Magnifique (r. 926-974 H / 1520-1566 J.-C.).

Il est possible qu’une équipe d’architectes et d’artisans d’Alep ait réalisé cette porte. Les registres du tribunal de la charia de Jérusalem possèdent les noms de certains des architectes de Jérusalem et d’Alep qui ont travaillé aux fortifications de la ville.
keywords: Portes ; fortifications ; architecture militaire

en.name: École Sadiki
short_description: Although its first home were disused barracks, the École Sadiki moved to its current building on top of the kasbah in Tunis in 1897. It was designed by the French architect Maillet in a typical Arab style, and thus has the grandeur of official French buildings whilst also using shapes from traditional Arab architecture. Built on two floors, its internal layout is similar to Western architecture, but it recalls the Arab medina in its external ornamental features and decor, with arches on marble columns and Turkish capitals, and with cupolas, green-tiled cornices etc.
history: Built in 1875 by Sadok Pacha Bey's grand vizier the General Khaireddine (Khayr al-Din), l'École Sadiki was the first Tunisian school to introduce modern teaching and move away from a traditional religious education, a move characterised by the introduction of foregin languages and the mathematical and physical sciences. L'École Sadiki was a breeding ground for Tunisian intellectuals with a love for political protesting and Westernization.
keywords: Architecture; Andalusian style; Arab style
partner: Higher Institute for the Study of Contemporary History of Tunisia, University of Manouba

fr.name: Ecole Sadiki
short_description: L’établissement, logé au départ dans une caserne désaffectée à la médina, s’installa dans son édifice actuel sur les hauteurs de la casbah de Tunis en 1897. Il est l’œuvre de l’architecte français Maillet dans le style arabisance, alliant la majesté des édifices officiels français et les formes de l’architecture arabe traditionnelle. Edifié sur deux étages, le bâtiment présente une organisation interne similaire à celle des édifices occidentaux mais s’apparente à ceux de la médina arabe au niveau de la modénature et les décors : arcades reposant sur des colonnes en marbre avec des chapiteaux turquisants, existence de coupoles, corniches en tuiles vertes, etc.
history: Fondée en 1875 à l’initiative du grand vizir de Sadok Pacha Bey, le général Khaireddine, l’école Sadiki fut le premier établissement tunisien où s’organisa un enseignement moderne distinct de l’enseignement traditionnel religieux, caractérisé par l’introduction des langues étrangères et les sciences exactes. L’école Sadiki fut la pépinière d’une intelligentsia tunisienne à l’esprit revendicatif et occidentalisé.
partner: Institut Supérieur d’histoire contemporaine de la Tunisie, Université de la Manouba

ar.name: حمزنامة : المبعوثون يأتون بأخبار من مقاطعات خيبر وجين لأنوشروان
description: قام رقباء في الجيش بنبش كل أجزاء المملكة ووجدوا طوبتين قديمتين واحدة في خيبر والثاني في جين وقد تم جلب الطوبتين لأنوشروان وتم تبليغ إمبراطور السبع أقاليم وقد استدعى الملك الخواجة لحاشيته وبوجوده سأل الرقباء لماذا كانت البلدان بشكل خرائب وقال الرقباء أنه في خيبر كان هناك جبّار اسمه هشام والذي فعل كل شيء بمقدوره بشكل وحشي وظالم  بينما في جين بالرغم من أن الخاقان كان طيبا جدا فإن ابنه المدعو بهرام غور كان أنانيا وعنيدا وإن سكان هاتين المملكتين قد عذّبوا بسبب ظلم هذين الاثنين وبسببهما تحولت المملكتان إلى خرائب.
partner: المتحف التمساوي للفنون التطبيقية / الفنون المعاصرة

de.name: *Hamzanama*: Kundschafter bringen Anoschirvan Nachrichten aus den Ländern Chaiba und China
description: "Kommandanten eilten in alle Teile des Reiches und fanden zwei alte Ziegelsteine, einen in Chaibar und einen in China. Sie brachten die zwei Ziegelsteine zum Kaiser Anoschirwan und berichteten es dem Kaiser der sieben Weltgegenden. Der Kaiser rief den chwadscha zu sich und fragte die Kommandanten in seiner Gegenwart, warum die beiden Länder ruiniert waren. Die Kommandanten berichteten, dass es in Chaibar einen Heiden namens Hischamgab, der alle Grausamkeiten und Ungerechtigkeiten beging, die er konnte. In China war zwar der Kaiser sehr gut, aber er hatte einen Sohn namens Bahram Gur, der äußerst egoistisch und widerspenstig war. Die Untertanen dieser beiden wurden von ihrer Ungerechtigkeit gequält, und wegen ihnen waren die beiden Königreiche ruiniert."
holder: MAK – Österreichisches Museum für angewandte Kunst / Gegenwartskunst
partner: MAK – Österreichisches Museum für angewandte Kunst

en.name: *Hamzanama*: Emissaries bring news from the provinces of Khaybar and Chin to Anoshirvan
description: "Sergeants-at-arms hastened off to all parts of the realm and found two ancient bricks, one in Khaybar and one in Chin. They brought the two bricks to Anoshirvan and reported to the emperor of the seven climes. The king summoned the *khwaja* to his retinue and, in his presence, asked the sergeants why the two countries were in ruins. The sergeants reported that in Khaybar there was a guebre named Hisham who did everything he could by way of cruelty and injustice, while in Chin, although the Khaqan was very good, he had a son named Bahram Gur, who was extremely egotistical and unruly. The subjects of those two kingdoms were tormented by the injustice of those two, and on account of them the kingdoms were in ruins."
holder: MAK – Austrian Museum of Applied Arts / Contemporary Art
keywords: Painting; Hamzanama; Emissaries
partner: MAK – Austrian Museum of Applied Arts / Contemporary Art

ar.name: تطريز.
description: أرضية هذا التطريز مصنوعة من الشيفون الشفاف، وقد تم نثر الأزهار على كامل سطح القماش الناعم، وتنفيذها بدرجات متعددة من الحرير الملون، أما الحدود والأغصان فتم تنفيذها بالخيوط الذهبية. ويبدو من الدائرة الظاهرة في منتصف التطريز المربع الشكل تقريباً أن قطعة النسيج يحتمل أن تكون قد استخدمت كغطاء عمامة في حين أن كنيسة ريدارهولم في استوكهولم استعملت القطعة كغطاء لجرن المعمودية.

تطريز على قطعة شيفون شديدة الشفافية، مائلة إلى الاخضرار. ثمة شجيرات منتشرة على مجمل سطح القماش. ربما كانت القطعة المطرزة في الأساس غطاء لعمامة. أما خلال الفترة التي أصبحت فيها ملكاً لكنيسة ريدّارهولم في ستوكهولم فقد صارت تستخدم غطاء لحوض العمادة.
holder: كنيسة ريدارهولم، استوكهولم، تقدمة من إميرينتيا فون دوبن عام 1728.
dates: أوائل القرن الثاني عشر/ أوائل الثامن عشر.
keywords: تطريز؛ زخرفة زهرية؛ نسيج.
materials: تطريز من الحرير والشيفون موشى بخيوط ذهبية.
tags: تطريز من الحرير والشيفون موشى بخيوط ذهبية.

en.name: Embroidery.
description: The greenish ground material of this embroidery is very sheer chiffon. Blossoming shrubs are spread over the entire surface of this fine fabric, executed in gradated shades of different-coloured silk. The outlines and stems are made of gold thread. Judging from the circle in the middle, this nearly square textile could originally have served as a turban cover. While the textile was in Riddarholm Church in Stockholm it was used as a baptismal font cover.

Embroidery on a ground of very sheer, greenish chiffon. Blossoming shrubs are spread over the entire surface of the textile. The embroidery could originally have served as a turban cover. During the time it belonged to Riddarholm Church in Stockholm it was used as a cover for a baptismal font.
holder: Riddarholm Church, Stockholm, through donation of Emerentia von Düben in 1728.

es.name: Bordado
description: Tejido de fina gasa verdosa bordado en graduadas tonalidades de seda con tallos floridos repartidos por toda la superficie. El contorno de las flores y los tallos están bordados con hilo de oro. Por el círculo que decora el centro de esta tela cuadrangular, se deduce que era un cubreturbantes. Durante el tiempo que permaneció en la iglesia de Riddarholm (Estocolmo) se utilizó para cubrir la pila bautismal.

Tejido de fina gasa color verdoso bordado con tallos floridos en toda su superficie. Originalmente serviría para cubrir turbantes, aunque durante el tiempo que estuvo en la iglesia de Riddarholm (Estocolmo) fue utilizado para cubrir la pila bautismal.
holder: Iglesia de Riddarholm, Estocolmo, a través de una donación de Emerentia von Düben en 1728.

fr.name: Broderie
description: Cette broderie a été exécutée sur une mousseline de soie extrêmement fine de ton verdâtre. Des bouquets de fleurs répartis sur la totalité de la surface sont brodés dans des nuances graduées de fils de soie. Les contours et les tiges sont en fil d’or. Le cercle figurant au centre peut laisser penser que ce tissu de format pratiquement carré servait de couvre-turban. Il était utilisé dans l’église de Riddarholm à Stockholm pour recouvrir les fonts baptismaux.

Broderie sur très fine mousseline de ton  verdâtre. Des bouquets fleuris occupent la totalité de sa surface. Ce carré a pu servir de couvre-turban. Il a appartenu à l’église suédoise de Riddarholm où il couvrait les fonts baptismaux.
holder: Église de Riddarholm, Stockholm qui a reçu cette broderie d’Emrentia von Düben en 1728.

keywords: Broderies; décoration florale.

tags: Broderie de soie et de fil d’or sur mousseline.

ar.name: مبخرة
description: هذه المبخرة المصبوبة المجوفة هي بشكل طائر الحجل. ويمكن أن نشاهد أعمال التطعيم على كل الجسم والشغل المخرم على العنق والصدر والجناحين والظهر والذيل.المميز في الرأس هو العينين الرباعيتين المرتفعتين والأذنين والعرف المنحني بشكل طفيف.الرصائع والحجرات ذات الأشكال المختلفة ذات النباتات المستلقة والنماذج الهندسية والأزهار المتفتحة ذات البتلات الست موضوعة على الرأس والعنق. ومركز الصدر فيه فتحة رباعية ذات جارور. وإن لوحاتها مزينة بنباتات متسلقة مثقبة ومطعمة ونماذج هندسية. وأسفل الصدر مؤطر بنقش زاوي الذي يقطعه زهر متفتح سداسي البتلات والأجنحة مرتفعة ورؤوسها بارزة. والعناصر المطعمة والمثقبة يمكن أيضا أن توجد على الظهر والذيل للطائر. وإن أقدامه الثلاث تجعله مختلفا عن التمثيل الحقيقي ويجعله أقرب للمخلوق الأسطوري ويمكن أن تشاهد قطعة مشابهة في متحف المتروبوليتان( الرقم 2008.460).
keywords: مبخرة ، برونز ، مشغولة  معدنية ، مشغولة معدنية مطعمة ، إيران ، العالم الإيراني ، أفغانستان ، العالم الفارسي ، نقش ، طائر ، الطائر الطنان ،حيوان

partner: المتحف الجامعي للفن الإسلامي / مجموعة بوميلر

en.name: Incense Burner
description:
This hollow cast incense burner is in the shape of a partridge. Inlay work can be found on the whole body, openwork on neck, chest, wings, back and tail.  
Characteristic for the head are the quadratic, elevated eyes, ears and the slightly curved comb. Medallions and compartments of varying shapes with tendrils, geometric patterns and six-petalled blossoms are placed on head and neck. The centre of the chest has a quadratic opening with a drawer. Its panels are decorated with inlaid and perforated tendrils and geometric patterns. The bottom of the chest is framed by an angular inscription which is interrupted by a six-petalled blossom. The wings are elevated and its tips protrude. Inlayed and perforated elements can also be found at the back and tail.  
Its three feet differentiate it from a realistic representation and bring it closer to a mythical creature. A similar piece can be found in The MET (Inv.No. 2008.460).
holder: University Museum of Islamic Art | The Bumiller Collection
keywords: Incense burner; Bronze; metalwork; Inlaid metalwork; Iran; Iranian world; Afghanistan; Persian world; Inscription; Bird; Patridge; Animal
partner: University Museum of Islamic Art | The Bumiller Collection

ar.name: سجادة صلاة
description: هذه هي واحدة من تقريبا 90 سجادة صلاة أو مشكاة التي تعرف غالبا بمجموعة سالتينغ والتي يقبل عموما الآن بأنها حيكت في إيران في وقت ما في القرن السادس عشر أو السابع عشر. ويعتقد العديد من الناس أنها قد أتت من متحف قصر توبكابي (الذي ما يزال يحتوي 35 قطعة منها ) وقد بيعت خلال الأزمة الاقتصادية الناتجة عن الحرب الروسية – التركية لعام 1877- 8. ومن المحتمل جدا أنها كانت هدية دبلوماسية ودخلت قصر توبكابي قبل 1680 حيث يذكر في سجل الخزانة العامة لذلك العام سجاجيد الصلاة الفارسية ذات النقوش المطرزة  بخيوط معدنية. وقد قيل بأنها بقيت غير مستخدمة في مخازن القصر بسبب وجود نقوش متصلة بالصلوات اليومية الشيعية على بعض منها والذي يمكن أن يفسر بالألوان الناصعة وغالبا الحالة الممكن تمييزها للعديد من الأمثلة بما فيها هذه القطعة.تتألف النقوش على هذه السجادة من آية الكرسي وسور البقرة (2) ،الآية 255 في الحدود الخارجية وهناك سورة الأحزاب (33) الآية 56  في الحدود الداخلية . ورصائع الزاوية تحيط بعبارة "" العزة لله الأسمى / الأعلى ولحمده / مجده"". إن زوجا من السجاجيد المعروفة سابقا بسجادات صلاة "" بيريز"" موجودة  في مجموعة  خاصة في إيطاليا.
holder: عهدة عائلة الخليلي – مجموعة ناصر د. الخليلي للفن الإسلامي

en.name: Prayer rug
description:
This is one of approximately 90 prayer or niche rugs often known as a ‘Salting’ group which are now generally accepted as having been woven in Iran sometime in the 16th or 17th century. Many are believed to have come from the Topkapi Palace Museum (which still holds some 35 examples), sold off during the economic crisis resulting from the Russo-Turkish war of 1877–8. It is very likely that they were a diplomatic gift and that they entered the Topkapi Palace sometime before 1680, as a treasury ledger of that year mentions Persian prayer rugs with embroidered inscriptions in metal thread. It has been suggested that they may have remained unused in the Palace stores due to the presence of inscriptions integral to Shi‘i daily prayers on some of them, which may account for the bright colours and often remarkable condition of many examples, including this one.  
  
The inscriptions on this carpet consist of the *Ayat al-Kursi* (‘Throne verse’), *sura* *al-Baqara*, (II), verse 255, in the outer border and *sura* *al-Ahzab* (XXXIII), verse 56, in the inner one. The corner medallions enclise the phrase, ‘Glory to my most high Lord, and to His praise’. A pair to this carpet, previously known as the ‘Perez’ prayer rug, is in a private collection in Italy.
holder: Khalili Family Trust – Nasser D. Khalili Collection of Islamic Art
dates: AD 16th or 17th century; C-14 dating: 1474 –1667 (95% confidence)
keywords: Iran; Safavid; warp; weft; wool; silk; carpet; prayer rug; diplomatic gifts; metal thread; inscription
materials: Yellow silk warps and wefts; wool pile, in asymmetrical knot; metal-thread weft brocading

cs.name: Jezuitský kostel Nanebevzetí Panny Marie, Brno
description:
Trojlodní stavba je jednou z prvních barokních staveb na Moravě (1602). Monumentální oltář (1734–1737) má nad stříbrným tabernáklem kopii obrazu Madony z nejstarší mariánské svatyně, kostela Sta Maria Maggiore v Římě. Oltářní plátna i nástropní malby jsou dílem F. A. Schefflera, plastiky J. J. Schaubergera. Pozoruhodné jsou chórové lavice (1602–1605) a bočnice lavic  
v lodi (60. léta 17. století). Figurálně zdobené varhany na kruchtě nesené anděly jsou dílem A. Rigy (1728). Klenbu sakristie zdobí rokokový štukový dekor  
s girlandami a hlavičkami andílků.

Kolej založena r. 1578 je druhou nejstarší na Moravě. Výstavba komplexu se děla za velké podpory hlavního představitele rekatolizace Moravy, kardinála a knížete Františka z Dietrichštejna a jeho bratra, zemského podkomořího Zikmunda. Oba jsou pohřbeni před hlavním oltářem kostela. Kolej zanikla zrušením řádu r. 1773. Z původních objektů se zachoval jen portál koleje a kostel. Monumentální oltář nese kopii obrazu Madony z nejstarší mariánské svatyně, kostela Sta Maria Maggiore v Římě. Autor oltářích pláten a nástropních maleb byl žákem předního jihoněmeckého freskaře C. D. Assama.
artist:
Kardinál a kníže František z Dietrichštejna, zemský podkomoří Zikmund  
z Dietrichštejna, Řád jezuitů

Jan Křtitel Erna (1625? Brno – 1698 Brno); Mořic Grimm (1669 Achdorf – 1757 Brno); Jan Kašpar Pröbstl (? – 1729 Brno); Jan van der Furth; Baldissere di Anna (1560 Benátky – po 1639 Benátky); Felix Anton Scheffler (1701 Mainburg – 1760 Praha); Jan Jiří Schauberger (?, před 1725 Vídeň, činný v Olomouci – 1744 Brno); Ignác Raab (1711 Nechanice – 1787 Velehrad); Jan Adam Nesmann (1710 Mohuč – 1773 Brno); Ondřej Schweigl (1735 Brno – 1812 Brno); Anton Riga (cca 1660 Kaliningrad – 1728 Brno)
history: Kolej založena r. 1578 na místě středověkého ženského kláštera je šestou nejstarší v českých zemích a druhou na Moravě. Výstavba komplexu se děla za velké podpory hlavního představitele rekatolizace Moravy, kardinála a knížete Františka z Dietrichštejna a jeho bratra, zemského podkomořího Zikmunda. Oba jsou pohřbeni před hlavním oltářem kostela. Kolej zanikla zrušením řádu r. 1773. V budovách sídlila nejprve akademie, poté objekt sloužil jako kasárna. Byl značně poškozen za bombardování r. 1944 a kromě kostela následně zbořen.
keywords: Alegorie, jezuité, rekatolizace

en.name: Jesuit Church of the Assumption of the Virgin Mary, Brno
names: Jesuit Church of the Assumption of the Virgin Mary
description: The triple-nave building was among the first Baroque constructions in Moravia (1602). The monumental altar (1734–1737) has, over a silver tabernacle, a replica of a Madonna painting from the largest Marian church, Sta. Maria Maggiore in Rome. The altarpieces and ceiling paintings are by F. A. Scheffler. The sculptures are by J. J. Schauberger. The gallery pews (1602–1605), and the sides of the pews in the main nave (1660s), are particularly remarkable. The organ with figurative decoration in an organ-loft supported by angels is by A. Riga (1728). The sacristy vault is decorated with stucco featuring garlands and heads of *putti*.

Established in 1578 the college is the second oldest in Moravia. The construction of the complex took place with the support of the Cardinal and Count František of Dietrichstein, the prime mover of the Re-Catholicization of Moravia, and his brother, Provincial Vice-Chamberlain Zikmund. Both are buried in front of the high altar. The college ceased to exist with the dissolution of the Jesuit order in 1773. Only the college portal and the church of the original complex have survived. The monumental high altar features a replica of a Madonna painting from Sta. Maria Maggiore, Rome.
artist: Cardinal and Count František of Dietrichstein, provincial vice-chamberlain Zikmund, the Jesuits order

Jan Křtitel Erna (1625? Brno – 1698 Brno); Mořic Grimm (1669 Achtdorf – 1757 Brno); Jan Kašpar Pröbstl (? – 1729, Brno); Jan van der Furth; Baldissere di Anna (1560, Venezia – after 1639, Venezia); Felix Anton Scheffler (1701 Mainburg – 1760 Prague); Jan Jiří Schauberger (?, before 1725 Vienna, worked in Olomouc – 1744, Brno); Ignác Raab (1711, Nechanice – 1787 Velehrad); Jan Adam Nesmann (1710, Mainz – 1773, Brno); Ondřej Schweigl (1735, Brno – 1812, Brno); Anton Riga (cca 1660 Kaliningrad – 1728 Brno)
history: Established in 1578 on the site of a medieval convent, the college is the sixth oldest in Czech lands and the second oldest in Moravia. The construction of the complex took place with the support of Cardinal and Count František of Dietrichstein, the prime mover of the Re-Catholicization of Moravia, and his brother, Provincial Vice-Chamberlain Zikmund. Both are buried in front of the high altar. The college ceased to exist with the dissolution of the Jesuit order in 1773. The buildings housed an academy and later a barracks. The church sustained serious damage in the bombing of Brno in 1944.
keywords: Allegory, Jesuits, Re-Catholicization

ar.name: كتاب مهرجان الختان الإمبراطوري.
description:
يتناول 'كتاب مهرجان الختان الإمبراطوري' الاحتفالات التي جرت بمناسبة مهرجان ختان الأمير محمد بن السلطان مراد الثالث، التي استمرت 52 يوماً، ليلاً ونهاراً، في عام 990 / 1582. والكتاب يوثق، بالكلمة والصورة، كيف استعرضت الجمعيات الحرفية منتجاتها المختلفة خلال المهرجانات، وكيف نظمت شتى أنواع التسلية واللهو، وكيف رتبت الولائم ووزعت الأطعمة يومياً على الفقراء، وكيف كان السلطان يرشَّ الذهب والفضة على الناس بين وقت وآخر، وكيف خُتن الأطفال الفقراء ووُهبوا ملابس جديدة، وكيف جرى إسعاد المتسولين، وكيف أُطلق سراح السجناء المدينين بعد أن سُددت ديونهم. ولهذا السبب يعتبر الكتاب مصدراً تاريخياً يوفر لنا مدونات عن نمط الحياة العثمانية باقتصادها وحياتها الاجتماعية وثقافتها وفنها ووسائل تسليتها في القرن 10 / 16.  
  
جرى الاحتفال في ميدان سباق الخيل. وثمة وصف هنا لقصر إبراهيم باشا، والرواق ذي الطوابق الخشبية الثلاثة، الذي تم تشييده عند إحدى زوايا القصر، المخصص لاستخدامات موظفي القصر وممثلي الحكومات الأجنبية، وهو عنصر لا غنى عن إيراده ضمن مشاهد الكتاب.  
  
أحد هذه المشاهد يمثل معروضات جمعية صانعي الزجاج؛ حيث يجلس السلطان في شرفة مسيجة لقاعة المشاهدين في قصر إبراهيم باشا ويراقب الحرفيين وجموع الناس والضيوف الجالسين في الرواق. كما يعرض صناع الزجاج منتجاتهم، ويبينون مراحل الإنتاج والأدوات التي يستخدمونها بمساعدة فرن منصوب على عربة ذات عجلات.  
  
ثمة لوحة أخرى في الكتاب يظهر فيها موكب من المهندسين والمعمارين ومعهم نسخة طبق الأصل عن المسجد السليماني مصنوعة من الخشب والعاج. وهذه الصورة تسترعي الانتباه لأنها تمثل الفن العثماني بكل فخامته وشهرته، سواء من حيث رسوم المهندس سنان، الذي كان ما يزال حياً في هذه الفترة، وربما شارك في هذا العرض، أو من خلال الصرح الهائل الذي بناه: مسجد السليمانية.  
  
تم تحويل الاحتفالات في مهرجان الختان إلى قصة مرسومة ضمن 250 صفحة مزدوجة من المنمنمات مع مشاهد تشكيلية مماثلة عموماً لما رأيناه هنا.

إن السورنامة مخطوطة بالغة الروعة، تروي قصة مهرجانات ختان الأمير محمد، نجل السلطان مراد الثالث، التي أُقيمت في ميدان سباق الخيل، أمام قصر إبراهيم باشا في 990 هـ/1582م. إن المشهد، والاستعراضات والأحداث، موصوفة كتابة من جهة، ونمنمات زخرفية من ناحية ثانية.
artist:
في فصل من هذا الكتاب بعنوان ’وصف الرسام ومزاياه‘، يصف الكاتب انتظامي التحضيرات لهذا العمل، حيث يذكر أن نقاش عثمان (أحد مواطنيه من بلدة فوجا في حيرزغوينا) وفريقه قاموا بإعداده، على الرغم من أنه لا يذكر أسماء أعضاء الفريق. وثمة وثيقة مؤرخة في عام 997 (1588)، دونها مدَّاح البلاط سيد لقمان، تحكي عن رفع رواتب الفريق العامل في الحقلين التقني والكتابي، وتعدد أسماء أعضاء الفريق. وعلى الرغم من أنه يستحيل، بالاعتماد على هذه الوثيقة، تحديد أي العاملين كان يعمل في الحقل التقني وأيّهم في الحقل الكتابي (أو في كليهما)، تبقى الوثيقة مهمة نظراً لأنها تقدم فكرة عامة عن رسامين (نقاشين) وفنانين آخرين من الممكن أن يكونوا قد عملوا مع فريق نقاش عثمان. والأسماء التي ترد في هذه الوثيقة هي:  
الخطاطون: سيد قاسم؛ مصطفى؛ فيرام روز؛ علي؛ عبد الرحمن.  
مجلِّدو الكتب: عبدي شعبان؛ محمد حيدر؛ قارا محمد؛ محمد...؛ رجب عبد الله.  
الرسامون (النقاشون): عثمان؛ لطفي؛ علي؛ محمد حيدر؛ وليكان؛ محمد مصور؛ ملاَّ...؛ إبراهيم؛ عثمان \[آخر\]؛ أحمد عبد الله؛ حسين زرغوب؛ محمود مجيب؛ ...عبد الله...  
رسامو زخارف: موسى أحمد؛ يحي؛ سيدي؛ عبدي زرغوب؛ شعبان؛ خضر غازي؛ محمد عبد الله؛ محمد مصطفى؛ نصوح بن عبد الله؛ برويز عبد الله؛ عبد...يعقوب؛ داؤود عبد الله؛ يوسف عبد الله.
keywords: زجاج؛ زخرفة كتابية؛ سنان؛ قصر إبراهيم باشا؛ لوحة منمنمة؛ مسجد السليمانية.

en.name: *Surname-i Hümayun* (‘Book of the Imperial Circumcision Festival’).
description:
The *Surname-i Hümayun* ('Book of the Imperial Circumcision Festival') is a work dealing with the celebrations held for the circumcision festival of Prince Mehmed, son of Sultan Murad III, which lasted for 52 days and 52 nights in AH 990 / AD 1582. It documents, in both word and image, how during the festivities the craft guilds paraded their various products, how a variety of entertainments were organised, how banquets were held and food distributed to the public every day, how the sultan would scatter gold and silver among the people from time to time, how poor children were circumcised and given new clothes, how beggars were made happy, and how people who had been imprisoned for debt were granted their freedom by having their debts paid. For this reason the *Surname* is an important historical source providing for us a record of the AH 10th- / AD 16th-century Ottoman lifestyle; its economy, social life, culture, art and entertainment.  
  
The celebration was held in the Hippodrome, i.e. the 'Horse Square'. The Ibrahim Pasha Palace is depicted here, and the three-storey wooden spectators' gallery erected at one of its corners for the use of palace officials and representatives of foreign governments, is an indispensable element of the scenes in the *Surname*.  
  
One of these scenes represents the parade of the glassmakers' guild. Here the sultan, seated on the enclosed balcony of the audience hall in the Ibrahim Pasha Palace, watches the glassmakers' guild along with the assembled people and the guests sitting in the spectators' gallery. The glassmakers present the glass objects they have made, even showing the stages of glass production and the tools they use with the help of a furnace mounted on a wheeled wagon.  
  
Another painting in the *Surname* shows the procession of architects and engineers with a faithful replica of the Süleymaniye Mosque made of wood and ivory. This picture is noteworthy because it represents Ottoman art in all its splendour, celebrated in both the depiction of the architect Sinan, who was still alive in this period and probably participated in this parade, and, through his most monumental building: the Süleymaniye Mosque.  
  
The celebrations of the circumcision festival are transformed into a painted story through 250 double-page miniatures with compositions generally similar to the two seen here.

*Surname* is a magnificent manuscript telling the story of the circumcision festival of Prince Mehmed, son of Sultan Murad III, held at the Hippodrome in front of the Ibrahim Pasha Palace in AH 990 / AD 1582. The setting, processions and events are depicted both in writing and in miniatures.
type: Manuscript, paper, ink, watercolor, miniature painting
artist:
In the Surname, the writer Intizami describes the preparation of the work in a section entitled ‘Description of the painter and his qualities’, stating that it was prepared by Naqqash Osman (who, like himself, was from the town of Foça in Herzegovina) and his team, although he does not give the names of the members of the team. A document dated 997 (AD 1588) written by the court panegyrist Sayyid Loqman on the subject of raising the salaries of the team working on the Hünername and the Surname, though, does list the names of the team members. Although it is impossible to determine from this document who was working on the Hünername and who on the Surname (or on both), the document is important because it gives a general idea of which painters (naqqash in Turkish) and other artists might have been working on Naqqash Osman’s team. The names that appear in this document are:  
Calligraphers: Seyyid Kasım; Mustafa; Feramruz?; Ali; Abdurrahman.  
Bookbinders: Abdi Şaban; Mehmet Haydar; Kara Mehmed; Mehmed …; Recep Abdullah.  
Painters (naqqash): Osman; Lütfi; Ali; Mehmed Haydar; Velican; Mehmed Musavvir; Molla … ; İbrahim; \[another\] Osman; Ahmed Abdullah; Hüseyin Zergub; Mahmud Müzehib?; … Abdullah …  
Illuminators: Musa Ahmed; Yahya; Seydi; Abdi Zergub; Şaban; Hızır Gazi; Mehmed Abdullah; Mehmed Mustafa; Nasuh bin Abdullah; Perviz Abdullah; Abd … Yakub; Davud Abdullah; Yusuf Abdullah.
keywords: Miniature painting; calligraphy; glass; Süleymaniye Mosque; Ibrahim Pasha Palace; Sinan.
materials: Finished (aharlı) paper, ink, watercolour, gilding, leather (binding).
tags: Finished (aharlı) paper, ink, watercolour, gilding, leather (binding).

es.name: *Surname-i Hümayun* (
description:
*Surname-i Hümayun* ("Libro de la fiesta de la circuncisión imperial") es una obra que relata los festejos celebrados con ocasión de la circuncisión del príncipe Mehmed, hijo del sultán Murad III, que duraron 52 días y 52 noches en 990 / 1582. Documenta, con palabras e imágenes, la forma en que, durante los festejos, los gremios de artesanos mostraron al público sus artículos, se organizaron pasatiempos, se celebraron banquetes y se repartió comida al pueblo todos los días; cuenta también que el sultán repartió oro y plata entre la gente, se circuncidó y se entregó ropa nueva a los niños pobres, se hizo felices a los mendigos y se les concedió la libertad a los presos encarcelados por deudas, que quedaron saldadas. El *Surname* es una importante fuente de información histórica, ya que aporta un testimonio sobre el estilo de vida otomano del siglo X / XVI que abarca la economía, la vida social, la cultura, las artes y el ocio.  
  
La celebración tuvo lugar en el hipódromo, es decir, en la "plaza de los caballos". Una de las escenas que se ven aquí presenta imágenes del palacio de Ibrahim Paşa, así como de las gradas de madera de tres pisos que se construyeron en una de las esquinas para los oficiales de palacio y los representantes de gobiernos extranjeros; se trata de un elemento importante y recurrente en las escenas del *Surname*.  
  
Otra de las escenas representa el desfile del gremio de los vidrieros. En ella, el sultán, desde el balcón cerrado del salón de audiencias del palacio de Ibrahim Paşa, observa el desfile, del que también disfrutan el resto del público y los invitados sentados en las gradas. Los vidrieros presentan sus obras e, incluso, las fases de producción y las herramientas que utilizan, asistidos por un horno colocado sobre un carro con ruedas.  
  
Otra de las pinturas del *Surname* muestra el desfile de arquitectos e ingenieros, que portan una réplica fiel de la mezquita Süleymaniye hecha de madera y marfil. Cabe destacar esta pintura porque representa el arte otomano en todo su esplendor, reflejado en el retrato del arquitecto Sinan –que aún vivía en este periodo y probablemente participó en este desfile– y en su edificio más monumental: la mezquita Süleymaniye.  
  
Los festejos de la circuncisión quedan relatados en un cuento ilustrado de 250 páginas dobles repletas de miniaturas con composiciones similares a las que aquí se muestran.

El *Surname* es un magnífico manuscrito que cuenta la historia de la fiesta por la circuncisión del príncipe Mehmed, hijo del sultán Murad III, celebrada en el Hipódromo, frente al palacio de Ibrahim Paşa, en 990/1582. El escenario, los desfiles y los actos se representan por escrito y en iluminaciones.
artist: El escritor Intizami, en un capítulo del *Surname* titulado
keywords: Miniaturas; caligrafía; vidrio; mezquita de Süleymaniye; palacio de Ibrahim Paşa; Sinan.
materials: Papel trabajado *(aharlı)*, tinta, acuarela, dorado; encuadernación en cuero.

fr.name: *Surname-i Hümayun* (Livre de la fête de la circoncision impériale).
description:
Le *Surname-i Hümayun* (Livre de la fête de la circoncision impériale) est un ouvrage consacré aux fêtes données à l'occasion de la circoncision du prince Mehmed, fils du sultan Mourad III, qui durèrent 52 jours et 52 nuits en 990 H / 1582 J.-C. Il décrit par le texte et par l'image comment, à cette occasion, les guildes d'artisans ont présenté leurs activités, et documente les différents divertissements organisés, les banquets offerts, la nourriture distribuée chaque jour au public, les distributions d'or et d'argent par le sultan, la circoncision d'enfants pauvres qui reçurent des vêtements neufs, les dons prodigués aux mendiants, la libération de prisonniers pour dettes par le règlement de leurs engagements. Il constitue une importante source historique pour le style de vie ottoman au Xe siècle H (XVIe siècle J.-C.), le contexte économique et social, la culture, l'art et les divertissements.  
  
La célébration elle-même s'est déroulée à l'Hippodrome, c'est-à-dire sur la Place aux chevaux. Le palais d'Ibrahim Pacha y est représenté, ainsi que la galerie pour spectateurs à trois niveaux édifiée à l'un des angles de la place et réservée aux personnages officiels et aux représentants des états étrangers.  
  
L'une des scènes représente la parade de la guilde des verriers. Le sultan, assis sur le balcon fermé de la salle d'audience du palais d'Ibrahim Pacha, assiste au défilé de la guilde en compagnie d'hôtes et de divers personnages assis dans la galerie des spectateurs. Les verriers présentent des objets déjà réalisés, mais aussi les différentes étapes de la production du verre et les outils qu'ils utilisent à l'aide d'un four monté sur un chariot. Une autre peinture, accompagnée d'une fidèle reproduction en bois et en ivoire de la mosquée Sülemaniye, illustre la procession des architectes et des ingénieurs. Cette illustration est remarquable pour sa représentation de l'art ottoman dans toute sa splendeur à travers l'un des monuments emblématiques de l'époque. On y trouve même l'architecte Sinan, qui vivait encore et participa probablement à ces festivités.  
  
Les célébrations de la Fête de la circoncision sont ainsi racontées en 250 miniatures peintes sur double page, dans des compositions généralement similaires à celle reproduite ici.

*Surname* est un somptueux manuscrit qui relate l’histoire de la célébration de la circoncision du prince Mehmed, fils du sultan Mourad III, qui se tint à l’hippodrome en face du palais d’Ibrahim Pacha en 990 H / 1582 J.-C. Le texte et les miniatures décrivent tous deux le cadre, la procession et les évènements.
artist:
L’écrivain Intizami décrit dans le Surname la préparation de l’œuvre dans un chapitre intitulé “Description du peintre et de ses qualités”, précisant qu’il a été réalisé par Naqqash Osman (issu, comme lui, de la ville de Foça en Herzégovine) et de son équipe dont il ne nomme pas les membres. Le nom de ces artistes est fourni par un document daté de 997 H / 1588 J.-C. écrit par le panégyriste de la cour, Sayyid Loqman, qui mentionne une augmentation des salaires de l’équipe travaillant sur le Hünername et le Surname. Bien qu’il soit impossible de déterminer d’après ce texte qui travaillait sur le Hünername et qui sur le Surname (ou sur les deux), il offre une intéressante liste de peintres (naqqash en turc) et d’autres artistes travaillant auprès de Naqqash Osman :  
Calligraphes : Seyyid Kasım ; Moustafa ; Feramruz? ; Ali ; Abdurrahman.  
Relieurs : Abdi Şaban ; Mehmet Haydar ; Kara Mehmed ; Mehmed … ; Recep Abdullah.  
Peintres (naqqash) : Osman ; Lütfi ; Ali ; Mehmed Haydar ; Velican ; Mehmed Musavvir ; Molla … ; İbrahim ; \[un autre\] Osman ; Ahmed Abdullah ; Hüseyin Zergub ; Mahmoud Müzehib? ; … Abdullah …  
Enlumineurs : Musa Ahmed ; Yahya ; Seydi ; Abdi Zergub ; Şaban ; Hızır Gazi ; Mehmed Moustafa ; Nasuh bin Abdullah ; Perviz Abdullah ; Abd … Yakub ; Davud Abdullah ; Yusuf Abdullah.
keywords: Miniatures ; calligraphie ; verre, mosquée Süleymaniye ; palais d’Ibrahim Pacha ; Sinan
materials: Papier préparé (aharlı), encre, aquarelle, dorure, reliure en cuir.
tags: Papier préparé (aharlı), encre, aquarelle, dorure, reliure en cuir.

tr.name: Surname-i Hümayun.
description:
Surname 1582 yılında III. Murad'ın oğlu Şehzade Mehmed için düzenlenen ve 52 gün 52 gece boyunca süren sünnet düğünü şenliklerini ele alan bir çalışmadır. Yazmada şenlik sırasında İstanbul esnafının meslek dallarına ilişkin üretimlerini bir geçit töreni ile sundukları, çeşitli eğlenceler düzenlendiği, davetlilere ve halka her gün ziyafet ve yemekler verildiği, padişahın zaman zaman halka altın ve gümüş saçtığı, fakir çocukları sünnet ettirip giydirdiği, dilencileri sevindirdiği, borçlarından dolayı hapse düşenlerin borçlarını ödeyerek onları özgürlüklerine kavuşturduğu sözel ve görsel olarak belgelenmektedir. Eser bu yönüyle 10. / 16. yüzyıl Osmanlı yaşamını, ekonomisini, sosyal hayatını, kültürünü, sanatını ve eğlence hayatını gözler önüne seren tarihi bir kaynak niteliği taşımaktadır.  
  
Şenlik Hipodrom'da, yani At Meydanı'nda gerçekleşmiştir. Bu alanda bulunan İbrahim Paşa Sarayı, sarayın bir köşesine saray erkanı ve yabancı hükümet temsilcileri için yapılan üç katlı ahşap seyirlik binası eserdeki sahnelerin vazgeçilmez dekorunu oluşturmuştur.  
  
Bunu yansıtan örneklerden biri *camcılar loncasının geçişi*ni gözler önüne seren minyatürdür. Burada padişah, İbrahim Paşa Sarayı Divanhanesi'nin şahnişininden, ürettikleri cam objeleri sunan, hatta tekerlekli bir araba üzerine yerleştirdikleri seyyar fırın yardımıyla camın üretim aşamalarını ve kullandıkları aletleri sergileyen camcılar loncasını, meydanda küme olmuş halk ve seyirlik binasında oturan misafirlerle birlikte izlemektedir.  
  
Eserde mimar ve mühendisler grubunun *Süleymaniye Camii*'nin tahta ve fildişinden yapılmış çok benzer bir maketi ile geçişini gösteren bir diğer tasvir bu dönemde hala hayatta olan ve muhtemelen bu geçit törenine katılan Mimar Sinan'ı temsil etmesi ve onun en anıtsal yapısı aracılığıyla Osmanlı sanatının görkemini yansıtması açısından dikkat çekicidir.  
  
Sünnet düğünü şenlikleri eserde genelde bu iki sahnenin kompozisyon şemasında olan 250 çift sayfa minyatür ile resimsel bir öyküye dönüşmüştür.

*Surname,* 990 / 1582 yılında III. Murad'ın şehzadesi Mehmed için düzenlenen sünnet düğünü şenliklerini, olayın gerçekleştiği At Meydanı ve İbrahim Paşa Sarayı'nın oluşturduğu dekor içinde, sözel ve görsel olarak belgeleyen muhteşem bir çalışmadır.
artist:
Surname’de eserin hazırlanışını “Vasf-ı nakkaş ve sıfat-ı o” başlıklı bölümde anlatan yazar İntizami, Surname’deki minyatürlerin kendisi gibi Hersek’in Foça kasabasından olan Nakkaş Osman ve ekibi tarafından hazırlandığını belirtmiş, ancak bu ekip elemanlarının isimlerini vermemiştir. Şehnameci Seyyid Lokman tarafından Hünername ve Surname’de çalışan üretim ekibinin ücretlerinin arttırılması konusunda yazılan 1588 tarihli bir belgede ise ekip elemanlarının isimleri sıralanmıştır. Fakat bu listede adı geçenlerin hangisinin Hünername’de, hangisinin Surname’de ya da ikisinde birden çalıştığı tam olarak anlaşılamamakla birlikte belge Nakkaş Osman’ın üretim ekibi içinde yer almış olabilecek nakkaşlar ve eseri hazırlayan diğer sanatçılar hakkında genel bir fikir vermesi açısından önem taşımaktadır. Belgede ismi geçenler şunlardır:  
Hattatlar: Seyyid Kasım, Mustafa, Feramruz?, Ali, Abdurrahman  
Mücellitler: Abdi Şaban, Mehmet Haydar, Kara Mehmed, Mehmed…, Recep Abdullah  
Nakkaşlar: Osman, Lütfi, Ali, Mehmed Haydar, Velican, Mehmed Musavvir, Molla…, İbrahim, Osman-ı diger, Ahmed Abdulah, Hüseyin Zergub, Mahmud Müzehib?, …Abdullah…  
Müzehhipler: Musa ahmed, Yahya, Seydi, Abdi Zergub, Şaban, Hızır Gazi, Mehmed Abdullah, Mehmed Mustafa, Nasuh bin Abdullah, Perviz Abdullah, Abd…Yakub, Davud Abdullah, Yusuf Abdullah.
keywords: minyatür; hat; cam; Süleymaniye; İbrahim Paşa Sarayı; Mimar Sinan
materials: Aharlı kağıt, mürekkep, suluboya, altın yaldız, deri.
tags: Aharlı kağıt, mürekkep, suluboya, altın yaldız, deri.

en.name: Betrothal of Mary (after Albrecht Dürer)
description: This stained glass panel was produced at the Kellner Workshop in Nuremberg, German in 1838 and is one of the earliest 19th century glass paintings. The composition is based on a copperplate engraving by Albrecht Dürer.

ar.name: درابزين رخامي صليبي.
description:
القطعة عبارة عن درابزين يتكون من تسعة عقود مدببة متجاورة متماثلة في الشكل والأبعاد ترتكز على أعمدة مزدوجة يبلغ عددها قرابة العشرين عموداً. وتختلف زخارف الأعمدة وكذلك زخارف تيجان الأعمدة عن بعضها البعض، ولكن الزخارف تتشابه في كل زوج من الأعمدة وفي كل زوج من التيجان. ويتوسط المسافة بين كل عقدين دائرة محفورة بالرخام. تأخذ تيجان الأعمدة أحد شكلين: الأول يشبه التيجان الكورنثية المعقدة دقيقة الصنع، والثاني يميل إلى البساطة وهو أقرب ما يكون إلى زهرة الرمان المحورة. وزخرفت العقود بزخارف محفورة تأخذ شكل شارة الفارس. وتتنوع تفاصيل زخارف الأعمدة التي تتميز بشكل عام باستخدام زخرفة تتكون من سلسلة من رقم "7" تلتف حول بدن العمود بشكل رأسي أو أفقي. وتستند العقود على بلاطات رخامية على شكل ألواح يرتكز كل لوح منها على تاجي زوج من الأعمدة.  
  
وكان هذا الدرابزين مثبتاً داخل المسجد الأقصى، وغالباً أن الغرض منه كان زخرفياً، ثم نقل إلى المتحف الإسلامي بعد أعمال الترميم. ويمكن الاعتقاد بأن هذه القطعة ترتبط من حيث مادة الصنع وتقنيات الحفر بإفريز صليبي يقتنيه المتحف كان قد نقل من قبة الصخرة في القدس. وقد تكون القطعة قد صنعت في نفس الورشة التي يرجّح أن يكون الإفريز قد صنع فيها والتي كانت قائمة في الحرم الشريف في الفترة الصليبية وأنتجت الكثير من القطع الرخامية المزخرفة.

درابزين رخامي، يتكوَّن من تسعة عقود مدببة متجاورة، متماثلة في الشكل والأبعاد، ترتكز على أعمدة مزدوجة، يبلغ عددها قرابة العشرين عموداً. والدرابزين هو من نتاج فترة الفرنجة (طراز الرومانيسك). وتتصف القطعة ببساطة المظهر، ودقّة الصنعة، كان مثبتاً في المسجد الأقصى، لأغراض زخرفية.
keywords: درابزين؛ درابزين رخامي؛ درابزين صليبي؛ المسجد الأقصى.

en.name: Marble balustrade.
description:
A marble balustrade consisting of nine adjoining pointed arches identical in form and dimensions, and supported by coupled columns of which there are close to 20. The details on the columns as well as on the capitals differ from each other but each pair of columns and their corresponding capitals are identical. The spandrel, the area between the arches, is ornamented with a series of carved marble circles. The column capitals assume one of two forms: the first resembles a finely detailed and knotted Corinthian capital and the second inclines more toward simplicity, approximating a whirling pomegranate blossom. The arches are decorated with carved ornamentation in the form of a knight's blazon. The decorative details on the pillars are varied but are distinguished generally by a chain of number “7s” wrapped around the body of the column in a vertical or horizontal format. The arches rest on marble panels, each supported by a pair of capitals on top of the coupled columns.  
This balustrade was originally in the Aqsa Mosque, where it is likely that its function was decorative. It was then transferred to the Islamic Museum following the renovation of the mosque. It is possible that this piece is tied to, with regard to the material, craftsmanship and technique of carving, a Crusader frieze (also at the Museum), which was transferred from the Dome of the Rock. Perhaps this piece was crafted in the same workshop as an atelier renowned for its high-quality carved marble was active in the Haram al-Sharif during the same period.

This is a marble balustrade composed of nine adjoining tapered arches, identical in form and dimensions. They are supported by pairs of close to 20 pillars. The balustrade is a product of the Crusader period (Romanesque style).  It is relatively simple in appearance and detail. It was placed in al-Aqsa Mosque for decoration.
holder: Islamic Museum, al-Aqsa Mosque / al-Haram al-Sharif.
keywords: Balustrade; marble.

es.name: Balaustrada de mármol.
description:
Balaustrada de mármol con nueve arcos apuntados contiguos, idénticos en tamaño y forma, que descansan sobre unas veinte columnas pareadas. Las columnas y capiteles de cada par son idénticos, pero los pares difieren todos entre sí. El espacio entre arcos está decorado con círculos de mármol tallado.  
Hay capiteles de dos estilos: unos recuerdan a los capiteles corintios, con finos detalles y nudos; y los otros son más sencillos, con un adorno que parece una flor de granada abierta y rizada. Los arcos están decorados con un blasón de caballero. La decoración de cada par de columnas es diferente, pero casi todas presentan una cadena de sietes, en horizontal o vertical, que recorre el fuste. Los arcos descansan sobre impostas de mármol sostenidas por los pares de capiteles.  
Esta balaustrada estuvo originalmente en la Mezquita al-Aqsa, donde seguramente cumplió una función decorativa. Después de la restauración de la mezquita, se trasladó al Museo Islámico. A juzgar por el material, la factura y la técnica de la talla, es posible que estuviera relacionada con un friso del periodo de las Cruzadas (también en el museo) procedente de la Cúpula de la Roca; quizá ambas piezas se produjeran en el taller del Haram al-Sharif, famoso por la calidad de sus tallas, que estaba en funcionamiento en este periodo.

Balaustrada de mármol con nueve arcos de forma troncopiramidal, idénticos en forma y tamaño, sobre alrededor de veinte columnas pareadas. Se trata de una obra de la época de las Cruzadas (estilo románico), sencilla en composición y detalles, que decoraba la Mezquita al-Aqsa.
dates: Siglo VI de la Hégira / XII d. C.
keywords: Balaustrada; mármol.
partner: Museo islámico en la mezquita de Al-Aqsa

fr.name: Balustrade en marbre.
description:
Balustrade en marbre composée de neufs arcs brisés contigus de forme et de dimensions identiques, soutenus par une vingtaine de colonnes jumelées toutes différentes, de même que leurs chapiteaux. Les écoinçons sont ornés de cercles sculptés dans le marbre. Les chapiteaux sont de deux styles : le premier d'un d'esprit corinthien finement exécuté, le second plus simple, figurant une sorte de fleur de grenadier ouverte. Les arcs sont décorés de blasons de chevaliers. Les ornements des piliers sont des variations sur le thème du zigzag horizontal ou vertical. La succession d'arcs repose sur le tailloir des chapiteaux.  
Cette balustrade se trouvait à l'origine dans la mosquée al-Aqsa où elle remplissait une fonction sans doute décorative. Son matériau et sa technique de sculpture la rapprochent d'une frise de l'époque des croisés (également conservée au musée) transférée du Dôme du Rocher. Peut-être a-t-elle été réalisée dans le même atelier de travail du marbre qui était actif au Haram al-Charif à la même période.

Balustrade en marbre composée de neufs arcs brisés contigus de forme et de dimensions identiques, soutenus par une vingtaine de piliers jumelés. Elle a été réalisée à l’époque des Croisés en style roman. Cette balustrade d’aspect plutôt simple remplissait une fonction décorative dans la mosquée al-Aqsa.
holder: Musée islamique, mosquée al-Aqsa / Haram al-Charif.
dates: VIe siècle de l’Hégire (XIIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: Balustrades ; marbre

ar.name: عقد مكتوب عليه نقش آية الكرسي
description: آية الكرسيتعد آية الكرسي من أكثر الكتابات شيوعا في الحلي العُمانية، وهي الآية رقم (255) من سورة البقرة، وتؤكد هذه الآية على قوة الله سبحانه، وتعالى في هذا الكون. قال الله تعالى فيها: ""الله لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم لا تأخذه سنة ولا نوم له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض من ذا الذي يششفع عنده إلا بإذنه يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم ولا يحيطون بشيء من علمه إلا بما شاء وسع كرسيه السماوات والأرضرض ولا يئوده حفظهما وهو العلي العظيم (٢٥٥)"". ""صدق الله العظيم""(سورة البقرة)
dates: القرن الثالث عشر - الرابع عشر الهجري /  القرن التاسع عشر - العشرين الميلادي
keywords: عقد ، مجوهرات ، آية الكرسي

en.name: Necklace Inscribed with the *Ayat al-Kursi*
description:
The *ayat al-Kursi* (Throne Verse) is one of the most widely used inscriptions in Oman jewellery. Comprising the 225th verse of the second half of the Noble Quran, is provides an emphatic description of God's power over the universe. Usually referred to as "The Verse of the Throne", in translation it reads:  
'Allah, There is no God but Him, the Living, the External One. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes  
Him. He is what the Heavens and the earth contains. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is beyond and behind men. They can grasp only that part of His  
knowledge which He wills. His throne is as vast as heavens and the earth, and the preservation of  
both doesn't weary Him. He is the Exalted, the Immense One.
keywords: Necklace; Jewellery; Ayat Al-Kirsi

en.name: Plate and ablution ewer
description:
The porcelain plate depicts a ritual washing ceremony, in which a servant pours water from an ewer for ablution. This scene illustrates the importance of cleanliness and ritual purity in Ottoman daily and religious life. The accompanying basin and ewer set, produced in the Süleymaniye workshop tradition, reflects the same function represented in the image. Such basin–ewer sets were commonly used indoors for ablution (*wudu*), particularly before prayer, as well as for washing hands after meals.  
  
Beyond their practical purpose, these objects held symbolic meaning, emphasising purity, hospitality and respect for religious practice. Through both the visual narrative on the porcelain plate and the physical form of the basin and ewer, the work highlights the central role of water in Ottoman ceremonial, domestic and spiritual culture.
holder: İstanbul Su Müzesi / Istanbul Water Museum
keywords: Water; ewer; ablution; plate; *wudu*

en.name: *The Crisis in Egypt – Panoramic View of Cairo 1882*
short_description: This expansive, panoramic engraving focuses of the Citadel of Cairo with the majestic Ottoman-style mosque erected by Muhammad Ali Pasha in memory of his son Tusun at the centre. The view is taken from high up in the Moqattam range, allowing the viewer to appreciate a panorama that takes in the wide expanse of the city of Cairo beyond the fortress, all the way to the river Nile. In composing the image, dated to 1882 CE - the year of the Anglo-Egyptian war, the artist H. W. Brewer most probably drew on contemporary photographs. Little is known about this British illustrator who specialised in depictions of cities viewed from the air.The print was issued as a supplement to The Graphic 1882. The Graphic was a British weekly illustrated newspaper, first published on 4.12.1869 by William Luson Thomas’s company Illustrated Newspapers Limited. By 1882, it had over 1000 employees. The Graphic’s influence on the art word was considerable, its readers including Vincent van Gogh.
holder: Sharjah Art Museum / Sharjah Museums Department

en.name: 'The War on Trial'
names: Anticolonial booklet published by the Italian Socialist Party, against Italian colonial expansion in Libya
short_description:
This booklet describes an imaginary trial against Giovanni Giolitti, the Italian Prime Minister who directed the colonial conquest of Libya in 1911-12. The judge asks Giolitti:  
– ‘Why did you get into other people’s home?’  
– ‘In order to defend our interests.’  
– ‘Good! And what about the slaughtering of women and children, the massacre of elderly people, and the hanging of men?’  
– ‘You see, your excellence, we needed to uplift Italian prestige.’  
– ‘And what about the thefts, the burnings and the planes that bombed huts?’  
– ‘It was our civilising mission.’ "
keywords: cartoon; caricature

en.name: Photograph attached to a request to migrate to Argentina by Domenica De Paola of San Severino Lucano (PZ), Italy
São Salvador (Parish Church)
description:
"Documents relating to the Parish Church of Santa Cruz indicate that it dates back to 1479, when Gil Eanes built the Chapel of Jesus in the early building that was to be substituted by the  
“New Church”, so-called in contrast to the previous “Old Church”. However, there is also a lot of information about the resultant building that has survived to the present day and was dedicated  
to São Salvador.  
On January 25th 1502, D. Manuel I ordered the local inhabitants to complete the main vessel of the church and told the *almoxarife*, or administrator, to begin work  
on the chancel, for which the King was responsible as patron, although it was then donated to João de Freitas for his tomb. In 1508, the building work was being directed by the Master  
Builder, Fernão Mouseiro, whose first assistant was a certain Diogo. Work lasted for several years, at least until 1511.  
The façade, showing the different heights of the nave, has two large  
buttresses built after the Manueline period, and a Gothic portal with columns of various diameters alternating with foliate capitals surmounted by a bull’s-eye window. The Manueline bell-and  
watchtower with its belfries and pyramidal *spire* rises at the apse end; a good example of the typical Manueline towers that have since disappeared from other parish churches on the  
island.  
The main vessel is divided into three separate aisles by simple, unornamented arcades. The apse is covered by ribbed vaulting, that forms an octagonal shape in the centre with  
decorated bosses displaying the Royal arms, the shield of Portugal, and the Cross of Christ. The double door of the sacristy, divided into two by a central pillar, is of an unusual design and  
ornamental richness, with elegant, lowered polylobed arches and half spheres decorating the *archivolt* and walls. The Late Gothic side chapel of São Tiago (St James), built by João de  
Morais before 1522 is also of interest, with armorial bearings on the keystone of the semicircular entrance arch and naturalist capitals.  
The funerary niche belonging to Micer Batista, a  
knight and merchant from Genoa who lived in the town, is in the same style and is dated 1516. Also note the open niche next to the baptismal font, designed to serve as a cupboard, which is  
a good example of the Manueline style."

en.name: Order of the Osmanie that belonged to Alexandru Ioan Cuza
short_description: Alexandru Ioan Cuza, ruler of the United Principalities of Moldova and Wallachia, received the order of Osmanie in June 1864, when he travelled to Istanbul in order to convince the sultan to agree with the changes he planned to make to the Paris Convention of 1858, which was the Principalities’ constitution. In May the modified act was approved by plebiscite in the Principalities and as a consequence a conference of the Guaranteeing Powers was organized in Istanbul. Cuza spent two weeks in Istanbul and had talks with the sultan and the ambassadors of the Guaranteeing Powers. He managed to achieve his goal since on 28 June, the representatives of the Ottoman Empire, France, Great Britain, Prussia, Russia and Sardinia authorized *The Additional Act to the 1858 Convention*.
keywords: military order; Istanbul

en.name: *Turtledoves* paperweight
description: Paperweight made up of two full-rounded turtledoves in mould-blown and pressed blue glass. This piece was produced at the artist's factory in Wingen-sur-Moder, Alsace, where, from 1922 onwards, Lalique would produce everyday objects for widespread consumption.
materials: Mould-blown and pressed glass with patina

en.name: Villa Augusta (V. dei Villini 2)
description:
The villa, also called White Villa (Villa Bianca), is located at the beginning of the territory of Ariccia coming from Albano, along via Appia Nuova (via dei Villini, n. 2), on the right. It was built in 1910 in neoclassical style and purchased in 1918 by Cavalier Oreste Bianchi, who decorated the park with archaeological finds. The villa hosted Gregory Peck in the summer of 1952 during the filming of "Roman Holiday". After ownership passed to the Ramacci family in 2007, the building went through a radical restoration between 2009 and 2010.  
(Bibliography: A. Martorelli, 1930)

en.name: Fragment of a rug
description:
Uşak, western Anatolia, was one of the most important carpet-making centres in the Ottoman Empire. The carpets made there are of a very high standard of workmanship, with well-balanced compositions, and a harmonious use of colour. The Iranian influences are visible in the precise and very detailed treatment of motifs. The most beautiful Uşak carpets were made during the 16th and 17th centuries (we can trace them also in paintings). It is now believed that carpets from the “Uşak” group were also made in Anatolian towns.  
Uşak rugs can be divided into five groups concerning their pattern and colour. The “white rug” group, with grounds of un-dyed wool, ivory or pale beige, with a pattern of *cintamani* motifs, so-called “birds”, or “scorpions”, were probably made in Selendi. According to the sources, “bird rugs” were known in Poland from at least the 16th century. We know that the Polish king Stephen Báthory, the former Transylvanian prince, in 1585, commissioned carpets described as “white with red paint, as in Turkey they commonly make, with birds”. At the beginning of 17th century, the Archbishop of Lviv, Jan Andrzej Próchnicki ordered a “bird rug” with his coat of arms – it is now preserved in Medelhavsmuseet, Stockholm. Representations of white-ground rugs were also painted on the walls of Tarnow burghers’ houses at the end of 16th century.  
The Kraków rug can be assigned to the “white rug” group, but its ornament is very specific. While it most closely resembles a “bird rug”-type, “bird-like” forms are substituted with “dragon-like” motifs. In the preserved fragment, we can see four rows of star-like rosettes. Each of these is flanked by “dragons”. Delicate cloudbands and palmettes, connected with geometricised scrolls, decorate the border. It is worthy of note that both the pattern and the colour of the rug are very sophisticated and that the ornaments are delicate and detailed. As for the use of colour, the Kraków rug differentiates itself against the others in the “white rug” group for its ornaments, woven in nicely chosen shades of blue, red, pink, orange and emerald-green.
keywords: Turkey; Uşak; Selendi; ‘white-rug’ group; bird rugs; Ushak
materials: Wool (warp, weft, pile); symmetrically knotted pile

en.name: *Ali Bey (Domingo Badia y Leblich), Traveller*
names: *Ali Bei (Domenico Badia y Leblich) celebre viaggiatore*
description: Ali Bey, a pseudonym used by Domingo Badia (1767–1818), was a Spanish explorer and spy. He travelled to the Ottoman Empire and North Africa under the identity of a Syrian prince. He published his experiences in different books. His travel descriptions had success in Europe and were translated into several languages. The descriptions reveal his admiration and respect for the Arab world.
keywords: Spies; Portrait in Oriental dress
materials: Paper; ink; stipple engraving; pencil-manner engraving

en.name: *Ceres*
description:
The rondel represents Ceres, the goddess of wheat and harvest and symbol of the fertility of the earth and of agriculture, in a landscape that evokes the harvest of cereals. A mythological figure, sometimes confused with the Greek figure Demeter, Ceres can be identified by her two attributes: the sickle and the sheaf of wheat. She was widely depicted in Europe during the Renaissance thanks to isolated engravings as well as mythographies that fixed her appearance and attributes.  
  
Curiously, this rondel does not seem to correspond to any pre-existing iconographic model, whether ancient or Renaissance, and the costume and headdress of Ceres, devoid of any indication, make attribution and dating uncertain. However, a date prior to the engraving by Hieronymus Cock after Lambert Lombard (1568) appears unlikely, since the rondel features the same motif of a cart drawn by two horses.
keywords: Stained glass; Ceres; agriculture; ancient history; classical antiquity; earth; fertility; goddess; gods; history; mythology
materials: Transparent glass rondel, in one piece, painted with grisaille and silver stain
tags: Transparent glass rondel, in one piece, painted with grisaille and silver stain

en.name: *Mashrabiyya*
short_description: The *mashrabiyya* is a decorative architectural element characteristic of residences in the Arab world. It was generally used on windows or balconies on the second floor or above. As well as being a natural ventilation device, the *mashrabiyya* served the purpose of shielding the occupant from the vision of passers' by, whilst still allowing natural light to pass through the gaps. This particular piece is square shaped and made of limestone, sculpted in floral patterns.
keywords: Floral decoration; floral art; Architecture

en.name: Male head
description: South Arabia (Yemen) has always been famous for its incense. The cultivation and widespread trade of this desirable product turned Yemen into a very important region with a highly autonomous culture. This kind of head, sculpted on tombstones, portrayed the subject partly as abstract idealization and yet in a very naturalistic way.
dates: Beginning of 1st millenium AD South-Arabia; brought to Vienna by Edward Glaser in 1882–1894
keywords: Yemen; Eduard Glaser; Museum of Fine Arts Vienna

en.name: *Constantinople et le Bosphore de Thrace*
short_description: With the political developments of 19th century, interest in the East increased steadily in the western world. Everything belonging to the East was the centre of interest for western observers. Travelling in the 19th century became easier and more reliable due to the advent of steamships and trains. Westerners travelled to the East not only for touristic purposes, but also for scientific research, history, archaeology or for religious reasons. Western travellers told of their experiences and what they saw in eastern countries in their travel books and they even offer advice about the journey. Istanbul, where East and West meet, has been the subject of many a traveller's book.
keywords: travel books; travelling; orientalism; Istanbul

en.name: *St. Florian*
description:
The wooden statue of *St. Florian* has a counterpart, *St. Donatus*, both of which are one and a-half times life-size. Both pieces were transferred to the National Museum in Budapest on permanent loan from the town of Körmöcbánya (Kremnica) in 1892. There is documentary data to confirm that *St. Florian* was part of the interior furnishing of the Parish Church of Our Lady, on which Stanetti worked between 1763 and 1764.  
In 1880 a landslide meant that the church was demolished and that the furnishing was taken out of the church and scattered among various locations. Most of the statues are now in Slovakian museums.  
It is known that the two gilded statues *St. Donatus* and *St. Florian* were originally placed independently in the nave. The two saints, which belong to the age of imperial Rome, had been revered since the Middle Ages as protectors from lightning, hailstorms and fire.  
The sculptures portray both saints as sturdy athletic men with reserved gestures, and their heroic poses are borrowed from stone sculpture similar to those erected near to vineyards and wheat fields. *St. Donatus* wears a wreath of leaves on his head and holds a bundle of lightning bolts to his chest; the sheaf of wheat that he originally held in his left hand is lost. Helmeted *St. Florian* has a burning house at his feet and a pail in his right hand. The flag from his left hand is lost.  
Dionysius Ignatius Stanetti, who made both sculptures, was a descendant of a noted Silesian dynasty of sculptors. His uncle, Johann (Giovanni) Stanetti perhaps toured Italy and was employed by the court circle in Vienna. Dionysius Stanetti moved to Hungary in the 1740s. He was married in Körmöcbánya (Kremnica) and was a burgher of the town until his death. Apart from the Late Baroque furnishings in the churches of the neighbourhood, he also created monumental public memorials: the Holy Trinity columns in Besztercebánya (Banská Štiavnica) and Körmöcbánya (Kremnica).

The Silesian, Dionysius Ignatius Stanetti, settled in Hungary. His sculptures from Upper Hungarian mining towns are well known. The church of Körmöcbánya (Kremnica) was demolished in the 1880s after a landslide and consequently the Baroque furnishings were scattered throughout the region. The two quality sculptures of *St. Donatus* and *St. Florian* were both deposited by Kremnica town in trust to Budapest.
keywords: St. Florian; St. Donatus; Dionysius Stanetti; Johann (Giovanni) Stanetti; mining towns in Upper Hungary; Silesia; Körmöcbánya; Kremnica; Kremnitz; Selmecbánya; Schemnitz; wood carving; gilding; religious object
