en.name: Dish with floral decoration.
description: Large plate with a broad flat base, curved sides and a narrow brim, painted in turquoise green, cobalt-blue and red lake in relief (Armenian bole) typically used with this type of dish. It consists of flowering stems that, like the central shoot with its blue campanulas, spring from a small bush with small alternating blue and red roses that is painted on the lower edge of the base of the dish. The flowers are dominated by three large peonies, tulips and hyacinths. The brim is decorated with the characteristic ‘wave-and-rock’ motif, highly stylised. The side is decorated with rose and palmette motifs that alternate between green and blue, with colour haloing.
This plate, a typical example of work from the factories of Iznik in the AH late 10th–early 11th / AD late 16th–early 17th centuries, is richly decorated with floral motifs.
holder: Museum of Civilisations | Museum of Oriental Art “Giuseppe Tucci”
keywords: Dish; ceramic; glazed; floral decoration; Iznik; hyacinths
partner: Museum of Civilisations | Museum of Oriental Art

es.name: Plato con decoración floral.
description: Gran plato de base ancha y plana, pared curva y borde estrecho, pintado en verde turquesa, azul cobalto y rojo laca aplicado en relieve (bol arménico), típico de esta clase de platos. Está decorado con tallos florecidos que brotan, como la rama central con campanillas azules, de un pequeño arbusto con diminutas rosas azules y rojas alternadas pintado en la parte inferior del fondo del plato. Entre las flores destacan tres peonías grandes, tulipanes y jacintos. El vuelo está decorado con el característico motivo “de olas y escollos”, aunque muy estilizado. En la pared se intercalan palmetas y rosetas azules y verdes de bordes aureolados.
Típico producto de las fábricas de İznik entre finales del siglo X / XVI y principios del XI / XVII. El plato presenta una rica decoración floral.
holder: Museo de Civilizaciones | Museo de Arte Oriental “Giuseppe Tucci”
dates: Siglo X o XI de la Hégira / XVI-XVII d. C.
keywords: Plato; cerámica; decoración floral; vidriado; Iznik; jacintos
partner: Museo de Civilizaciones | Museo de Arte Oriental

fr.name: Plat à décor floral.
description: Grand plat à large base plate, marli bombé et aile réduite, peint en vert-turquoise, bleu cobalt et rouge laque en relief (“bol arménien”), typique de cette catégorie de plats. Sur le bord intérieur du fond du plat, un buisson de rosettes alternativement bleues et rouges génère des tiges fleuries et le rameau central à campanules bleues. Parmi les fleurs dominent trois grosses pivoines, des tulipes et des jacinthes. L'aile est ornée du motif caractéristique de “vagues et rochers”, très stylisé. Sur le marli figurent, alternés, des motifs de palmettes et de rosettes peints en bleu et en vert, avec un halo de couleur.
Produit typique des fabriques d'Iznik entre la fin du XVIe et le début du XVIIe siècle, ce plat présente de riches décorations florales.
holder: Musée des civilisations | Musée d'art oriental “Giuseppe Tucci”
dates: Xe siècle de l’Hégire (XVIe siècle J.-C.) ; XIe siècle H (XVIIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: plat ; céramique ; vernissage ; décor floral ; jacinthes
partner: Musée des civilisations | Musée d'art oriental “Giuseppe Tucci”

it.name: Piatto con decorazione floreale.
description: Grande piatto a larga base piana, parete ricurva e breve tesa, dipinto in verde-turchese, blu cobalto e rosso lacca steso a rilievo (bolo armeno), tipico di questa classe di piatti; essa consiste in steli fioriti che nascono, come il tralcio centrale con campanule blu, da un piccolo cespuglio a roselline alternativamente blu e rosse, dipinto sul margine inferiore del fondo del piatto. Fra i fiori dominano tre grosse peonie, tulipani e giacinti. La tesa è ornata con il caratteristico motivo “a onde e scogli”, molto stilizzato. Sulla parete figurano motivi a palmetta e a rosetta che si alternano nei colori blu e verde, con alonatura del colore.
Tipico prodotto delle fabbriche di İznik tra la fine del XVI e l'inizio del XVII secolo, il piatto presenta ricche decorazioni floreali.
holder: Museo delle Civiltà | Museo d’arte orientale “Giuseppe Tucci”
keywords: Piatto; ceramica; invetriatura; decorazione floreale; İznik; giacinti
partner: Museo delle Civiltà | Museo d’arte orientale “Giuseppe Tucci”

en.name: Layard Freedom Casket
short_description: A commemorative piece custom made to honour Austen Henry Layard. Layard was famous for excavating Nineveh. Closely modelled on the sculptures discovered by Layard.
keywords: Assyrian revival

en.name: Relief
description: Cereals and olive oil were the bases of the local diet, wealth and trade. Their production expanded in al-Andalus thanks to technical innovations such as hydraulic and irrigation systems. Their implementation facilitated the control of agricultural cycles and changed working methods. Farming expanded into arid lands, increasing and diversifying harvests. The diversity of cultivated grains –wheat, rye, etc.– made it possible to develop multiple recipes for bread, an essential food shared by the whole of society.
keywords: Agriculture; Technical innovation; Diet; Trade

de.name: Bogenring aus Nephrit
description: Diese Ringe aus Halbedelstein waren jeweils für den Daumen der rechten Hand des Bogenschützen bestimmt und dienten als Hilfsmittel zum Spannen der Bogensehne. Als wesentlicher Teil einer Waffe, die im Orient hohes Ansehen besaß, sind solche reich verzierten Daumenringe ideale Elemente zur Selbstdarstellung des Kriegers.

en.name: Nephrite thumb ring
description: Archers wore thumb rings made of semi-precious stone on the thumb of their right hand to help them draw their bows. A seminal part of a weapon held in high esteem in the Orient, these richly-embellished thumb rings were ideal expressions of a warrior’s status and wealth.
dates: Hegira second half of the 10th century / AD 2nd half of the 16th century
keywords: Military object; Ottoman army; floral decoration; arms; armours

ar.name: غوشتاسب يضع إسفانديار في السلاسل ، صفحة من مخطوطة الشهنامة (كتاب الملوك)
description: إن إسفانديار ،الابن الأكبر والأمير المتوج للملك الإيراني الأسطوري غوشتاسب تم اتهامه زورا بالتخطيط للاستيلاء على مملكة والده . ووالده الذي لا يعرف الحقيقة أمر بتقييده بالسلاسل وسجنه في حصن جبلي وفي معركة لاحقة مع أعدائه ندم الملك على تصرفه وحرر إسفنديار بحيث استطاع أن يقدم المساعدة العسكرية له وقد تم تصوير غوشتاسب هنا وهو على عرشه ويرتدي ثوبا أزرق وكان اللون الأزرق يستخدم كثيرا في اللوحات الفارسية ليشير للأشخاص الرئيسيين خاصة الملوك.

en.name:
Gushtasp puts Isfandiyar in chains  
Folio from a manuscript of *Shahnameh* (Book of Kings)
description: Isfandiyar, eldest son and crown prince of the legendary Iranian king Gushtasp, was falsely accused of planning to seize his father’s kingdom. Not knowing the truth, his father ordered Isfandiyar chained and imprisoned in a mountain fortress. In a later battle with enemies, the king regretted his act and had Isfandiyar released so that he could provide military assistance. Gushtasp is portrayed here enthroned, wearing a blue robe. Blue was frequently used in Persian painting to signify key figures, particularly kings.
keywords: Folio; work-on-paper; works-on-paper
materials: Opaque watercolour, ink, and gold on paper

description: الخزف المينائي، أو الهفت رنكي (المطلي بالمينا، و"السبعة ألوان" بالفارسية)، هو نوع من الفخار التصويري الإيراني، يتطلب معرفة تقنية وموارد مالية لإدارة عدة جولات من الحرق. يصور هذا الوعاء مشهداً من الشاهنامه: تقديم رأس الجنرال آين قشاب المقطوع إلى خصمه، الحاكم بهرام تشوبينا. قدم الرأس الجندي الذي قتل الجنرال.

en.name: *Mina´i* painted bowl
description: Mina'i or haft-rangi ("enamelled", and "seven-coloured" in Persian) ceramics are a kind of Iranian figurative pottery that required technological knowledge and financial means to manage several rounds of firing. This bowl depicts an episode from the Shahnama: the presentation of the severed head of the general Ayin Ghashap to his opponent, the ruler Bahram Chubina. The head is presented by the soldier who murdered the general.
keywords: Bowl; Minai; Kashan; Ceramics; Iran; Seljuk; Khawarezmid
materials: Fritware, Pigment, Paint; Minai Painting, Glazing

ar.name: دورق.
description:
القطعة عبارة عن دورق من الزجاج يمتاز برقته وجمال نسبه. ويتكون هذا الدورق من قاعدة مخروطية الشكل تنتهي من أسفل بحلقة بارزة، وبدن ذي أكتاف مائلة ينحدر جزؤه السفلي باستدارة إلى الداخل، ورقبة طويلة رشيقة تنتهي بفوّهة متعرجة قليلاً. يزين بدن الدورق رسومات نباتية من الأرابسك منفذة بالمينا والتذهيب داخل ثلاث دوائر بسيطة، وتشتمل هذه الرسومات على أزهار لوتس محوّرة مرسومة باللون الأبيض على أرضية زرقاء من المينا. وتحمل رقبة الدورق كتابة مذهبة بحروف دقيقة يظهر فيها اسم السلطان الناصر صلاح الدين يوسف. ويزين فوهة الدورق أشرطة زخرفية بسيطة.  
  
الدورق كما هو واضح من الكتابات المدوّنة عليه يخص السلطان الأيوبي الناصر يوسف الثاني، ملك حلب ودمشق في الفترة 634 - 658 هـ / 1237 – 1260 م. ويعتبر أسلوب الرسم على الزجاج بالمينا من الأساليب الزخرفية التي عُرفت في العصر الأيوبي وانتشرت في العصر المملوكي. ويتوزع عدد لا بأس به من الدوارق المموهة بالمينا بين متاحف العالم المختلفة. ويوجد أحد هذه الدوارق في متحف برلين، ويظهر عليه رسومات لفرسان يلعبون لعبة البولو، ويرجع هذا الدورق إلى العصر الأيوبي في القرن 7 هـ / 13 م ومصدره سوريا.

بلغت صناعة التحف الزجاجية الإسلامية أوج عزّها في مصر وسوريا، فيما بين القرنين 6-9 هـ / 12-15 م، تحت رعاية سلاطين الأيوبيين والمماليك. وكان فخر هذه الصناعة تزيين التحف بالزخارف المذهَّبة، والمموَّهة بالمينا، وتمثِّل هذه القطعة هذا الأسلوب.
keywords: تذهيب؛ دورق؛ زجاج ؛ زخرفة نباتية؛ مينا.

en.name: Glass carafe.
description:
A glass carafe that is distinguished by its delicacy and beautiful proportions. It is composed of a conical-shaped base, the bottom of which is a prominent circle. The body is characterised by sloping shoulders, the lower portion of which slopes into a round bowl. Its long, elegant neck terminates with a slightly undulating mouth. The body is decorated with arabesque vegetal motifs executed in enamel and gilding inside three simple roundels; one of which holds a stylised lotus blossom depicted in white against a background of blue enamel. The neck of the vessel bears a gilded inscription in small letters on which the name Sultan al-Nasir Salah al-Din Yusuf appears. The mouth of the vessel is embellished with simple decorative bands.  
It is clear from the inscription that the vessel was designated to the Ayyubid Sultan, al-Nasir Yusuf II, the ruler of Aleppo and Damascus in the period AH 634–58 / AD 1237–60. Enamel-painting on glass is considered to be a popular decorative style of the Ayyubid period, which became widespread in the Mamluk period. A considerable number of these vessels with enamel decoration are found in various museums worldwide. A similar vessel in the Museum of Islamic Art in Berlin is decorated with a painting of two horsemen playing polo. It dates to the Ayyubid period in the AH 7th / AD 13th century and originated in Syria.

The production of glass reached its peak of excellence in Egypt and Syria in the AH 6th–9th / AD 12th–15th centuries under the patronage of the Ayyubid and Mamluk Sultans. Many glass pieces were decorated with gilding and enamel, of which this is fine example.
keywords: Gilding; vessel/carafe; glass; vegetal decoration; enamel; arabesque
materials: Glass, decorated with coloured enamel and gilding.
tags: Glass, decorated with coloured enamel and gilding.

es.name: Botella de vidrio.
description:
Esta botella de vidrio destaca por su delicadeza y sus bellas proporciones. Está compuesta por un pie cónico que se sostiene sobre un anillo prominente; un cuerpo globular que se estrecha hacia el cuello y que está decorado con motivos vegetales en arabesco esmaltados y dorados dentro de tres sencillos medallones, uno de ellos con una estilizada flor de loto pintada en blanco sobre fondo azul esmaltado; y un cuello largo y elegante de labio ligeramente ondulado y que está adornado con una inscripción dorada de pequeñas letras con el nombre del sultán al-Nasir Salah al-Din Yusuf y, en la boca, con líneas horizontales simples.  
La inscripción deja patente que la botella estaba destinada a al-Nasir Yusuf II, soberano de Alepo y Damasco en el periodo 634-658 / 1237-1260. El esmaltado sobre vidrio constituye un estilo decorativo popular en la época ayyubí que se generalizó en la época mameluca. En los museos de todo el mundo se conserva una cantidad considerable de botellas esmaltadas, como por ejemplo la del Museo de Arte Islámico de Berlín, decorada con la pintura de dos jinetes jugando al polo, que data del siglo VII / XIII (época ayyubí) y se fabricó en Siria.

La producción de vidrio alcanzó su apogeo en Egipto y Siria en los siglos VI-IX de la Hégira / XII-XV d. C. con el mecenazgo de los sultanes ayyubíes y mamelucos. Muchas piezas se decoraban con técnicas de dorado o esmaltado, como la de este ejemplo.
dates: Siglo VII de la Hégira / XIII d. C.
keywords: dorado; jarrón/frasco; cristal; decoración vegetal; esmalte.
materials: Vidrio decorado con esmaltes de colores y dorado.
tags: Vidrio decorado con esmaltes de colores y dorado.

fr.name: Carafe en verre.
description:
Carafe en verre remarquable par la délicatesse et la beauté de ses proportions. Elle se compose d'un pied conique reposant sur un cercle débordant, d'une panse à épaule marquée fermant une partie inférieure hémisphérique, d'un col long et élégant se terminant par une lèvre légèrement ondulée. La panse est décorée de trois rondeaux meublés de motifs végétaux en arabesques et exécutés à l'émail et à la dorure. L'un d'entre eux représente une fleur de lotus stylisée en blanc sur fond d'émail bleu. Le col porte une inscription en petites lettres dorées donnant le nom du sultan al-Nasir Salah al-Din Youssouf. L'extrémité du bec est ornée de bandeaux décoratifs simples.  
L'inscription indique clairement que ce récipient a été conçu pour le sultan ayyoubide al-Nasir Youssouf II, souverain d'Alep et de Damas de 634 à 658 H /1237-1260 J.-C. La peinture à l'émail sur verre est un style décoratif ayyoubide populaire qui se répandit au cours de la période mamelouke. Un nombre considérable de ces récipients figurent dans les musées internationaux. Un modèle similaire appartenant au Musée d'art islamique de Berlin est orné d'une peinture représentant deux cavaliers jouant au polo. Il date de la période ayyoubide (VIIe siècle H / XIIIe siècle J.-C.) et vient de Syrie.

La production de verre atteint son apogée en Égypte et en Syrie au VIe-IXe siècle H (XIIe-XVe siècle J.-C.) sous le patronage des sultans ayyoubides et mamelouks. De nombreuses pièces en verre étaient décorées avec de la poudre d'or et de l'émail, à l'instar de cette superbe carafe.
dates: VIIe siècle de l’Hégire (XIIIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: Dorure ; carafes ; verre ; décoration végétale ; émail
materials: Verre à décor émaillé et doré.
tags: Verre à décor émaillé et doré.

en.name: Grain Silos
description:
A work of Mulay Isma‘il’s doing, the House with Ten Norias is part of a tripartite compound which consists of a trapezoidal building, a series of parallel barrel vaults whose ceilings have crumbled, the silos, and a trapezoidal basin, the Basin of the Norias. A building with a functional utility, it stands as evidence of Mulay Isma‘il’s desire to endow his city with infrastructures which would allow him to be prepared for all eventualities, to be armed against possible dangers from abroad, and to fulfil his ambitions through safeguarding his city’s imperial status in the same way as Fez and Marrakesh safeguarded theirs.  
  
**The House with Ten Norias**  
Inside this building, a series of cramped rooms surround a central, more spacious chamber of scantly built barrel vaults, and a corridor winds itself around this central massif by lining a system of 15 rooms covered with 12-piece conical vaults. Originally, each round room contained a *noria*, that is to say a deep well that reached the phreatic layer by means of a chain of buckets with pointed bases.  
The silos were built adjacent to this hydraulic scheme; silos which were too often incorrectly referred to as stables.  
  
**The Silos**  
A series of 22 arcades consisting of 14 arches each, a number of which were later blocked up, are located adjacent to the south-west wall of the building of the Ten Norias. These corridors were incorrectly called stables when they were in fact silos.  
Considered to be one of the most beautiful works accomplished by the Sultan Mulay Isma‘il, the building was intended to store food products, particularly wheat, as was noted by the historian al-Nassiri in the 19th century: “*Mulay Isma‘il also ordered for the construction of a granary to be built inside the kasbah which would be used for provisions, with vaulted corridors for the storage of wheat and other grains, which could hold enough grain to feed every inhabitant of Morocco*”.  
The mules which carried the wheat from different regions did not enter via the main gates of the building but crossed over an alleyway which brought them to circular openings pierced into the building’s terrace, into which the wheat was tipped. The building, constructed on an area of 182 m. in length and 104 m. in width, contained large rectangular rooms which were in fact underground granaries, even if today all their ceilings have collapsed and there is no longer a trace of “holes in the ceilings” which would have been used there. A central alleyway is maintained in a user-friendly condition as far up as to the back wall. Pillars, which hold up arches whose full arc measures 3 m. diametrically, divide the room into 18 bays and 23 naves, originally covered with barrel vaulting. This part of the *kasbah* is particularly impressive today; the picturesque and flowery expansiveness suits this series of hard-packed clay arcades marvelously.

es.name: Silos
description:
Obra del sultán Mulay Ismail, la Casa de las Diez Norias era parte de un conjunto tripartito formado por un edificio trapezoidal, una serie de bóvedas de cañón paralelas cuyos techos se han derrumbado (los silos) y un estanque trapezoidal (el Estanque de las Norias). Edificio con funciones utilitarias, atestigua la voluntad de Mulay Ismail de dotar a su lugar de residencia de infraestructuras que le permitieran estar preparada para arrostrar los peligros exteriores y desarrollarse salvaguardando su estatuto, como hicieron Fez y Marrakech.  
  
**Casa de las Diez Norias**  
En el interior de este edificio, una serie de salas exiguas rodea una estancia central más espaciosa, con bóvedas de cañón de fábrica somera. Un corredor circunda esta masa central, dando paso a un conjunto de 15 habitaciones cubiertas por bóvedas cónicas de 12 caras. En origen, cada una de estas piezas redondas albergaba una noria; es decir, un pozo profundo que llegaba a la capa freática y por el que subía el agua mediante un rosario de cangilones en forma de vaso con fondo puntiagudo.  
  
**Silos**  
Adyacente a la pared sudoeste de la Casa de las Diez Norias hay una serie de 22 arcadas, de 14 arcos cada una, algunos de los cuales han sido cegados posteriormente. Esta especie de soportales —llamados a menudo, erróneamente, “cuadras”— eran silos.  
El edificio, considerado como una de las más hermosas realizaciones de Mulay Ismail, estaba destinado a almacenar productos alimenticios, especialmente trigo, según narra el historiador al-Nasiri en el siglo XIX:  
“Mulay Ismail ordenó también construir en la alcazaba un granero con pasillos abovedados para almacenar el trigo y otros cereales, que podía contener grano bastante para todos los habitantes de Marruecos”.  
Los mulos que traían el trigo de las diferentes regiones no accedían por las puertas principales del edificio, sino que atravesaban una galería que los conducía a unas bocas circulares, practicadas en la azotea del edificio, por las que se vertía el grano.  
Así pues, el caserón, construido sobre una superficie de 182 x 104 m, albergaba enormes salas rectangulares que eran graneros subterráneos, a pesar de que hoy los techos están hundidos y no queda rastro de los “tragaluces” que debieron de practicarse en ellos. Hay una galería central transitable hasta el muro posterior; unos pilares sostienen arcos de medio punto, de 3 m de diámetro, que dividen la sala en 18 naves paralelas a la *qibla* y 23 perpendiculares cubiertas, en sus orígenes, por bóvedas de cañón.  
El aspecto actual de esta parte de la alcazaba es especialmente impresionante: hay un cierto abandono pintoresco que realza el encanto de esta serie de arcadas de tierra batida.

fr.name: Silo à grains
description:
Œuvre du sultan Moulay Ismaïl, la Maison aux Dix Norias fait partie d’un ensemble tripartite qui se compose d’une bâtisse trapézoïdale, d’une série de voûtes parallèles en berceaux dont les plafonds se sont écroulés, les silos, et d’un bassin trapézoïdal, le Bassin des Norias. Bâtiment à fonction utilitaire, il témoigne de la volonté qu’avait Moulay Ismaïl de doter sa ville d’infrastructures qui lui permettraient d’être prémunie contre les dangers extérieurs et de se développer en sauvegardant son statut de ville impériale comme le furent Fès et Marrakech.  
  
  
**Maison aux Dix Norias**  
  
À l’intérieur de cette bâtisse, une série de salles exiguës entourent une pièce centrale plus spacieuse, à voûtes en berceaux sommairement maçonnées, et un couloir contourne ce massif central en doublant un système de 15 pièces recouvertes de voûtes coniques à 12 pans. À l’origine, chaque pièce ronde abritait une noria, c’est-à-dire un puits profond atteignant la nappe phréatique au moyen d’un chapelet de godets en forme de vases à fond pointu.  
Contigus à cet ensemble hydraulique, des silos furent aménagés; silos trop souvent nommés à tort écuries.  
  
  
**Les silos**  
  
Une série de 22 arcades, de 14 arcs chacune dont certains ont été bouchés ultérieurement, se trouve adjacente au mur sud-ouest de la bâtisse aux Dix Norias. Ces couloirs ont été appelés à tort des écuries alors qu’il s’agit là de silos.  
Considéré comme l’une des plus belles réalisations du sultan Moulay Ismaïl, le bâtiment était destiné à entreposer les produits alimentaires, particulièrement le blé comme le note l’historien al-Nassiri au XIXe siècle:  
“*Moulay Ismaïl ordonna également la construction dans la casbah d’un grenier à provisions aux couloirs en voûte pour le blé et les autres grains, qui pouvait contenir les grains pour tous les habitants du Maroc*”. Les mulets qui amenaient le blé des différentes régions n’accédaient pas par les portes principales de l’édifice mais traversaient une allée qui les menait à des ouvertures circulaires percées dans la terrasse de l’édifice et dans lesquelles le blé était déversé.  
La bâtisse, construite sur un espace de 182 m de longueur sur 104 m de largeur, renfermait de larges salles rectangulaires qui étaient en fait des greniers souterrains, même si aujourd’hui tous les plafonds se sont écroulés et s’il n’y a plus de traces des “trous-plafonniers” qui devaient y être pratiqués. Une allée centrale est maintenue praticable jusqu’au mur postérieur. Des piliers soutenant des arcs en plein cintre de 3 m de diamètre divisent la salle en 18 travées et 23 nefs, couvertes à l’origine de voûtes en berceau. Cette impressionnante aujourd’hui; l’abandon pittoresque et fleuri convient à merveille à ces séries d’arcades en terre battue.

en.name: Glass
description:
Transparent, cylindrical, blown glass of slightly truncated conical form, with yellow and black decorative enamel. The rim is encircled by a sequence of 12 squares, each representing one of the signs of the zodiac. The names of the corresponding months are depicted below each of these squares, followed by a series of columns of three sections per row (with 11 rows in total), in which the days of the month are recorded. Some days are highlighted against a yellow background.  
  
The base of the glass features an image of Venus, to be discovered once the contents have been drained. The inscription "1920" forms an arc around the image, announcing the arrival of the new year.  
  
The object, created in 1919, reflects the modern Viennese graphic style that originated in the Wiener Werkstätte (Vienna Workshop), of which the artist was a member. According to Alberto Bartolomé Arraiza, the piece was most likely a special order.
keywords: Enamelled; Calendar; Zodiac; Venus; Wiener Werkstätte

es.name: Vaso
description:
Vaso cilíndrico ligeramente troncocónico, de vidrio soplado transparente. Decoración esmaltada en amarillo y negro. Presenta un registro superior con 12 cuadrados en los que se representan los signos del zodiaco. Bajo cada uno, el nombre del mes que le corresponde seguido de columnas reticuladas, con tres registros por cada fila (11 filas en total), en los que aparecen los días del mes. Algunos días del mes destacan sobre fondo amarillo.  
En el fondo del vaso aparece una imagen de Venus —para ser descubierta una vez apurado el contenido—, flanqueada por la inscripción "1920", que anuncia la llegada del año nuevo.  
El objeto, creado en 1919, revela el estilo gráfico moderno de Viena, iniciado en los Wiener Werkstätte (Talleres Vieneses), organización de la que formó parte el autor del. diseño. Según indica Alberto Bartolomé Arraiza, se trataría probablemente de un encargo especial.
keywords: Esmaltado; Calendario; Zodiaco; Venus; Wiener Werkstätte

en.name: Tibetan 'Three Medallion' Rug
description: 19th-century Tibetan rugs serve a variety of functions and come in many sizes. Their decorations consist mainly of Buddhist symbols. The Tibetan rug in the collection of the Museum of Applied Arts is a small and rectangular *khaden* (sleeping) rug called a "three-coin" or "three-medallion" rug because of its design. The four corners of the field contain light blue and light green swastikas in a pale-yellow spandrel with stepped edges. The brick red central field is adorned with three medallions surrounded by cloud motifs along the central axis. In the main border, lemon yellow and ochre strips meander. The minor border has a dark brown ground adorned with a row of pearls. The rug is framed by a 3-8 cm, knotted fringe of yak hair.
keywords: Khaden; Sleeping rug; Tibetan rug; Yak hair
materials: Warp and weft: Wool; Pile: Wool and Tibetan yak wool; Tibetan rug weaving technique: Jufti knot, open to the left
tags: Pile: Wool and Tibetan yak wool

en.name: Nusretiye Mosque and Tophane Square
short_description: James Robertson arrived in Istanbul in 1840 and started work as head etcher in Ottoman Mint. He began taking photos of Istanbul soon after. There was previously a mosque located on the site of the current Mosque, which was known as the Mosque of the Artillery Barracks (Tophane-i Amire Arabacilar Kislasi Camii) built by Selim III (1789-1807). When that mosque was destroyed by the Firuzaga fire, the Nusretiye Mosque, located on Meclis-i Mebusan Street in the Tophane District of Beyoglu, was built on the order of Sultan Mahmud (1784-1839), and was constructed by the Krikor Amira Balyan. The construction lasted from 1823 to 1826 and was broadly restored between the years of 1955 and 1958, and partially again between 1980 and 1992. While its architecture is influenced by Islamic elements, it retains a Baroque style, making it unique to the city.
keywords: Photograph; Old İstanbul Photograph; İstanbul; James Robertson

en.name: *Oud* (Incense)
description: Incense is traditionally used — and particularly on special occasions — to perfume one’s clothing, hair and body, and scent the home to welcome and honour guests. Three popular types of incense in the UAE and the Gulf region are *liban* (frankincense) a resin from the *Boswellia* tree species; *Bukhoor*, a mixture of aromatic woods, spices and oils; and the rare and expensive *Oud*, made from shavings of agarwood (*Aquilaria* species) infected by a fungi (*Phialophora parasitica*). The infected wood produces a dense and fragrant protective resin, which releases a unique scent when heated.
dates: Hegira mid 14th century / AD mid 20th century
keywords: Incense; Oud

en.name: City Walls
description: The existing walls were restored in the time of D. Manuel I, although they were originally built much earlier. The general structure dates from the time of the Muslim emirs, as can be seen by the bases of some of the remaining towers and the surmounted arch of the town gate (Porta da Vila). The two *barbican* towers next to the Arco do Repouso must also date from the Almohad era.

ar.name: شخص على حصان
description: هذا التمثال الصغير لشكل كالحصان يحمل سلة أو براميل /طبول من كل طرف.وبالرغم من أن جسم الحيوان مثل الجمل والرأس مثل الحصان. وهو مرسوم بواسطة زجاج فيروزي والخطوط التحديدية محددة خارجيا بلون أزرق داكن. والقطع التشكيلية مثل هذه تم تصنيعها منذ بداية العصور الإسلامية مع كون ذروة إنتاجها خلال العصر السلجوقي. والقطع التي وجدت في الرقة ، الري ، قاشان/كاشان وسلطان آباد تشير لورشات في هذه المناطق صنعت العديد من هذه القطع. ولكن الكيفية ولماذا استخدمت هذه القطع هو غير مؤكد ولكن هذا التمثال الصغير له وظيفة تزيينية حيث أن وزنه  الكبير يحد من استخدامه.

en.name: Figure on a horse
description: This statuette of an equestrian figure holds a basket or drums on each side. Though the body of the animal looks like a camel, the head is horse-like. Painted with a turquoise glaze, the contours are outlined in a dark blue colour. Figurative objects like this one have been manufactured since early Islamic times, with the heyday of production occurring during the Seljuq period. Fragments found in Raqqa, Rayy, Kashan, and Sultanabad indicate that workshops in these areas manufactured many of these objects. How and why these objects were used is uncertain, but this statuette most likely served a decorative function as its heavy weight restricts use.
keywords: Frit ware; sculpture
materials: Fritware; alkali glaze and cobalt blue under a transparent glaze
tags: alkali glaze and cobalt blue under a transparent glaze

ar.name: زبدية ذات فتاتين ترقصان وشجرة مزهرة وعصابات من النقش
description: صنعت هذه الزبدية بتقنية المينا والتي طورت من قبل صناع الفخار في كاشان وكانت شائعة جدا في القرن الثاني عشر. وقد وعرفت أوعية المينا باستخدام أصبغة ملونة تحت الزجاج. ومثل العديد من الأوعية التي صنعت خلال هذه الفترة فإن الزبدية ملونة بألوان خفيفة ومطلية بالذهب فوق الزجاج وقد شويت عدة مرات.داخل الزبدية مزين بشخصين يرقصان حول شجرة مزهرة صغيرة ويتطاير مايضعانه على رأسيهما. وحافة الزبدية منقوش عليها بالخط الكوفي تمنيات للمالك بالسعادة. وتشبه الصورة الملونة اللوحات المنمنمة في هذا العصر وهي تذكّر بحياة الحاكم والمناسبات الثقافية للمنطقة وربما تشير إلى عيد النوروز وهو السنة الجديدة الإيرانية .
dates: أواخر القرن السادس – بداية القرن السابع الهجري / أواخر القرن الثاني عشر – بداية القرن الثالث عشر الميلادي
keywords: ميناي ، خزف

en.name: Bowl with two dancing girls, a flowering tree and bands of script
description:
This bowl was made in the *mina’i* technique, which was developed by potters in Kashan and was very popular in the late 12th century. *Mina’i* ware is identified by the use of coloured pigments under the glaze. Like many vessels made during this period, the bowl is coloured with muted colours and gold overglaze and was fired several times.  
The Inside of the bowl is decorated with two figures dancing around a small flowering tree, their headdresses flying. The edge of the bowl is inscribed in *kufic* script, wishing the owner happiness. The colourful picture resembles miniature paintings of the era and it is reminiscent of the rural life and cultural ceremonies of the region, possibly referring to Norouz, the Iranian New Year ceremony.
dates: Hegira late 6th century-early 7th century / AD late 12th-early 13th century
keywords: Minai; Ceramics
materials: *Mina'i* ware; fritware, paint (gold and other pigments)

ar.name: عرش السلطان أحمد الأول.
description:
يعتبر عرش السلطان محمد الأول أحد أفضل نماذج الصناعة الخشبية العثمانية في القرن 11 / 17. صنع العرش على شكل مظلة تتوجها قبة، وله ثلاث درجات منخفضة تؤدي إلى الكرسي المفرد.  
  
صنع العرش معلم القرن 11 / 17 البارز محمد آغا، كبير مهندسي القصر العثماني. إنه قطعة فسيفسائية أخاذة مؤلفة من عروق اللؤلؤ وعظم السلحفاة جنباً إلى جنب مع عدد لا حصر له من الأحجار الكريمة.  
  
صنع العرش من خشب الجوز؛ وتمت زخرفة سطحه بالكامل بفسيفساء من عروق اللؤلؤ وعظم السلحفاة. كما تضم الزخرفة النباتية الخزامى والقرنفل والورود وعود الصليب، وكلها متصلة ببعضها بعضاً بواسطة أغصان لولبية معترشة تنبثق من مزهرية. وقد نفذت الأشكال النباتية من خلال عروق اللؤلؤ بأسلوب طبيعي، وغطيت المساحات الباقية بعظم السلحفاة.  
  
أما الجزء الداخلي لكرسي العرش فتزينه مجموعة من التصاميم المنفذة بتقنية البرنيق، المعروفة بـ "إديرنكاري." وهنالك رسوم زهرية مصبوغة بالأصفر على خلفية حمراء منفذة بطريقة بسيطة. وهذه الرسوم الزهرية، التي تعكس النمط المميز للفترة الكلاسيكية العثمانية، منضدة بطريقة ناجحة جداً. كما أن إضافة الأحجار الكريمة، مثل الزمرد واليشب والفيروز والماس، أكسبت المزهرية والورود حيوية أكبر، فالألوان المتنوعة للأحجار جعلت العرش أكثر سحراً.  
  
يعتبر العرش واحداً من القطع العديدة التي تبرز غنى القصر العثماني. إنه أحد الأمثلة الهامة للنوعية الرفيعة التي بلغها الفن العثماني في الزخرفة النباتية في القرن 11 / 17.

هذا العرش البديع المُرصَّع بالأصداف والذبل والعديد من الأحجار الكريمة والدُّرر، صُنع للسلطان أحمد الأول. والرسوم النباتية تعكس الفترة العثمانية الكلاسيكية، وقد جرى تنفيذها في تشكيلات نابضة بالحياة، بقدرٍ كبير من النجاح.
place: مشاغل قصر الباب العالي في استنبول، تركيا.
artist: معلم تطعيم عرق اللؤلؤ: محمد آغا (توفي في الربع الأول من القرن 11 / 17).

en.name: Throne of Sultan Ahmed I.
description:
The throne of Sultan Ahmed I is one of the best examples of 11th / 17th century Ottoman woodwork. Made in the form of a baldachin, the throne has three low steps that lead up to the one-person seat. The baldachin itself is crowned with a dome.  
  
The throne was made by the important 11th- / 17th-century architect Sedefkâr Mehmed Agha, the head architect of the Ottoman palace; it is dazzlingly beautiful with a mosaic of superb mother-of-pearl and tortoiseshell work side by side with countless precious gems.  
  
The throne is made of walnut wood. Its entire surface is decorated with a mosaic of mother-of-pearl and tortoiseshell. The vegetal decoration includes tulips, carnations, roses and peonies connected to each other by scrolling tendrils and rising from a vase. The vegetal motifs are executed in a naturalistic style in mother-of-pearl, while the remaining area is covered with tortoiseshell.  
  
The inner part of the seat of the throne is decorated with a composition of motifs in a lacquer technique known as *Edirnekari*. Floral motifs in yellow are painted against a red background in the naturalistic style.  
  
The floral motifs which reflect the characteristic style of the Classical Ottoman period are arranged in a most successful composition. The vase and the flowers themselves are further enlivened by the addition of precious gems, including emeralds, jade, turquoise, and diamonds. The use of precious gems in various colours makes the throne even more attractive.  
  
The throne is one of many objects which display the wealth of the Ottoman Palace. It is an important example of the high level of quality attained in vegetal decoration in 11th / 17th century Ottoman art.

This magnificent throne with superb mother-of-pearl and tortoiseshell inlay work and numerous gems was made for Sultan Ahmed I. The floral motifs reflect the classical Ottoman period and are successfully rendered in very lively compositions.
type: Woodwork, wood, lacquered, gems, mother of pearl, tortoise shell
dates: During the reign of Sultan Ahmed I (Hegira 1011–26 / AD 1603–17).
artist: Sedefkâr (‘mother-of-pearl master’) Mehmed Agha (died 1st quarter of the 11th / 17th century).

materials: Wood, lacquered (Edirnekari technique), and inlaid with mother-of-pearl, tortoiseshell, and gems (emerald, jade, diamond, turquoise, etc.).

es.name: Trono del sultán Ahmed I.
description:
El trono del sultán Ahmed I es uno de los mejores ejemplos de la ebanistería otomana del siglo XI / XVII. Tiene forma de baldaquín con tres escalones bajos que conducen al asiento, coronado con una cúpula. Este trono, en madera de nogal, fue fabricado por el importante arquitecto del siglo XI / XVII Sedefkâr Mehmed Agha, arquitecto jefe del palacio otomano. Está adornado con un magnífico mosaico de nácar y caparazón de tortuga combinado con abundantes piedras preciosas, lo que le confiere una belleza deslumbrante. Presenta decoración vegetal compuesta por tulipanes, claveles, rosas y peonías, unidos entre sí con zarcillos rizados que salen de un jarrón. Los motivos vegetales, de estilo naturalista, son de nácar; la superficie restante está cubierta de caparazón de tortuga.  
La parte interior del asiento del trono está decorada con una técnica de laqueado conocida como *edirnekari*. Presenta motivos florales en amarillo pintados sobre un fondo rojo en un estilo naturalista. Estos motivos, que reflejan el estilo característico del periodo clásico otomano, están dispuestos en una composición muy conseguida. El jarrón y las flores resaltan aún más por efecto de las piedras preciosas (esmeraldas, jade, turquesa y diamantes) que, con su variedad de colores, aportan al trono mayor belleza.  
La presente obra es uno de los numerosos objetos que ponen de manifiesto la riqueza del palacio otomano. Asimismo, constituye un importante ejemplo del alto nivel de calidad que alcanzó el arte otomano en el siglo XI / XVII en el terreno de la decoración vegetal.

Magnífico trono, con piedras preciosas y exquisitas incrustaciones de nácar y caparazón de tortuga, creado para el sultán Ahmed I. Los motivos florales son propios del periodo otomano clásico y están dispuestos en llamativas composiciones.
dates: Sultanato de Ahmed I (1011-1026 de la Hégira / 1603-1617 d. C.)
artist: Sedefkâr ('maestro del nácar') Mehmed Agha (m. primer cuarto del siglo XI / XVII).

materials: Madera; lacado (técnica *edirnekari*); incrustación de nácar, caparazón de tortuga y gemas (esmeralda, jade, diamante, turquesa, etc.).

fr.name: Trône du sultan Ahmed Ier.
description:
Le trône d'Ahmed Ier est un des meilleurs exemples du travail du bois ottoman du XIe siècle H (XVIIe siècle J.-C.). Il se compose de trois marches basses qui conduisent à un siège prévu pour une personne, l'ensemble étant surmonté d'un baldaquin couronné par un petit dôme.  
D'une fascinante beauté, étincelant de sa nacre, de ses incrustations d'écaille de tortue et d'innombrables pierres précieuses, il a été dessiné par le grand architecte ottoman du XIe/XVIIe siècle Sedefkâr Mehmed Agha, architecte en chef du palais de Topkapi  
Fabriqué en noyer, il est entièrement décoré d'une mosaïque de nacre et d'écaille de tortue. Le décor végétal comprend des tulipes, des œillets, des roses et des pivoines réunies par des enroulements de vrilles, s'élevant à partir d'un vase. Les motifs en nacre sont traités dans un style naturaliste, tandis que les zones intersticielles sont plaquées d'écaille de tortue.  
La partie intérieure du siège est décorée d'une composition de motifs floraux peints en jaune sur fond rouge en style naturaliste selon une technique de laque appelée *Edirnekâri*.  
Ces motifs qui reflètent le style caractéristique de la période ottomane classique constituent des compositions très réussies. Le vase et les fleurs sont par ailleurs animés par l'incrustation de pierres précieuses (émeraudes, jade, turquoises et diamants) qui rendent ce décor encore plus séduisant.  
Ce trône fait partie des multiples objets qui témoignent de la richesse du palais de Topkapi. Il est un exemple important du haut niveau qualitatif atteint par l'art ottoman au XIe/XVIIe siècle en décoration végétale.

Ce magnifique trône aux superbes incrustations de nacre, d’écailles de tortue et de nombreuses pierres précieuses fut fabriqué pour le sultan Ahmed Ier. Les motifs floraux reflètent la période classique ottomane et sont superbement interprétés dans des compositions très vives.
dates: Règne du sultan Ahmed Ier (1011-1026 de l’Hégire / 1603-1617 J.-C.).
place: Ateliers du palais de Topkapi, Istanbul, Turquie.
artist: *Sedefkâr* (“maître de la nacre”) Mehmed Agha (mort durant le premier quart du XIe H (XVIIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: bois ; trônes ; nacre ; écaille de tortue ; laque ; Edirnekari ; sultan Ahmed Ier ; Sedefkar Mehmed Agha ; décoration végétale
materials: Bois laqué à incrustations de nacre, d’écaille de tortue et de pierres précieuses (émeraude, jade, diamant, turquoise, etc.).

tr.name: Sultan I. Ahmed’in Tahtı.
description:
Sultan I Ahmed'e ait olan taht, 11. / 17. yüzyıl Osmanlı ahşap işçiliğinin mükemmel örneklerinden birini gözler önüne sermektedir. Baldaken tarzda yapılmış olan tahtın tek kişilik oturma alanına, yüksekliği fazla olmayan üç basamak ile ulaşılmaktadır. üst kısmı kubbe ile kapatılmıştır.  
  
11\. / 17. yüzyılın önemli mimarlarından ve Hassa mimarları başı Sedefkar Mehmed Ağa tarafından yapılan taht, mükemmel sedef ve bağa işçiliğinin yanı sıra üzerinde yer alan sayısız değerli taşlarla da göz kamaştırıcı bir güzelliğe sahiptir.  
  
Taht ceviz ağacından yapılmıştır. Bütün yüzeyi, sedef ve bağa malzemeyle, mozaik tekniği kullanılarak süslenmiştir. Bitkisel bezemeli süslemede, lale, karanfil, gül ve hatayi çiçekleri, kıvrım dallarla birbirine bağlanmış ve vazo içerisine yerleştirilmiştir. Natüralist bir üslupta işlenen bitkisel motifler, sedefle verilmiştir. Bu süslemelerin dışında kalan bütün alanlar bağa ile kaplanmıştır.  
  
Tahtın oturma kısmının içi, Edirnekâri adı verilen, lake tekniği kullanılarak (boyalı ve cilalı örnekler) yapılan motiflerin yer aldığı kompozisyonla bezenmiştir. Kırmızı zemin üzerine sarı çiçekler, natüralist bir üslupta işlenmiştir.  
  
Klasik Osmanlı dönemin özelliklerini yansıtan çiçekler, son derece başarılı bir kompozisyonla ele alınmıştır. Vazolar ve çiçeklerin üzeri, zümrüt, yeşim, firuze ve elmas gibi değerli taşlarla hareketlendirilmiştir. Değerli ve renkli taşların kullanılması tahtın çok daha göz alıcı olmasını sağlamıştır.  
  
Osmanlı sanatında, 11. / 17. yüzyılda bitkisel bezemin kullanımını ve ulaştığı noktayı göstermesi açısından önemli olan taht, Osmanlı Sarayının zenginliğini sergilediği eserlerden biridir.

Sultan I. Ahmed için yapılan taht, mükemmel sedef ve bağa işçiliği ve üzerinde yer alan sayısız değerli taşlarıyla göz kamaştırıcı bir güzelliğe sahiptir. Tahtın süslenmesinde kullanılan ve klasik Osmanlı dönemi özelliklerini yansıtan çiçekler, son derece başarılı kompozisyonlarla ele alınmıştır.
artist: Sedefkâr Mehmed Ağa (ö. 11. / 17. yüzyılın birinci çeyreği).

materials: Ahşap malzemeli taht, sedef, bağa ve değerli taşlarla (zümrüt, yeşim, elmas, firuze vb) kakma tekniğinde ve Edirnekâri (lake) tekniğinde süslenmiştir.

en.name: Municipal Museum
description:
"The Museum is housed in buildings that formerly belonged to the Convent of Jesus and which contains a number of masterpieces from the Manueline era.  
Firstly, there is an extraordinary series of 14 panels that include the retable from the Monastery chancel that was almost certainly directed by the Court Painter to D. Manuel I, Jorge Afonso, and can be dated to between 1520 and 1530.  
This large retable followed an iconographic plan in three levels corresponding to three cycles: the *Passion of Christ*, the *Childhood of Jesus* and the *Franciscan Saints*. The *Assumption of the Virgin* was probably also depicted, as usual in the centre, and there would have been a magnificent *Calvary* at the top. The use of various inspirational sources can be seen in another panel, the *Apparition of the Angel to St Clare, St Agnes and St Colette*, which reproduces the same theme as the painting by Quentin Metsys, also in this Museum, where the master has altered the architectural background to a Manueline building, which bears the coat of arms of Queen D. Leonor on the portal. Among the ambiguities that tend to characterise painted architecture during this period are other panels with Renaissance elements, such as the *Annunciation*, with its classical portal surmounted by a shell.  
The collection of silver and silver-gilt items contains some fine Manueline pieces donated by D. Manuel I and even by Ferdinand and Isabella of Spain, though the most important ensemble is from the Brotherhood of Nossa Senhora da Anunciada, which was integrated into the Misericórdia charity organisation in Setúbal in the 19th century. Dating from the end of the reign of D. João II, it includes an elegant cross in rock crystal, mounted in silver-gilt, the gift of the king’s chancellor, Nuno Gonçalves. An elegant silvergilt chalice dating from the same period is decorated with foliate motifs, with an architectural-style knot and representations of the Virgin Mary, St Peter and St James on the base.  
The remarkable reliquary of *Nossa Senhora da Anunciada* from a Lisbon workshop is, like many works of the period, an architectural fantasy structure, protecting an ivory image of the Virgin in a silver and glass case under a *baldachin*. In the knot on the stem is a relic of Christ’s Crown of Thorns, set between pieces of glass.  
Surprising in its rarity is a small silver bottle of holy oil that dates back to the first half of the 16th century and recalls some items of Chinese porcelain that were then being imported from the Far East."

en.name: Altar of St. Ignatius
description: Archbishop Emerik Esterhazy was the donor for the marble Altar of St. Ignatius. In its architectural structure, the altarpiece belongs to a type designed for jesuit churches by Andrea Pozzo. The two side sculptures represent the two Jesuit saints, St. Frances Regis and St. Frances Xavier.
place: The first side chapel of St. Ignatius on the left-hand (north) side of the nave

en.name: *The Temple of Venus*
short_description: Giuseppe Sciuti initially worked in his hometown as a decorator, then moved to Naples and Florence. In Florence, the artist works with the Macchiaioli painters upon subjects linked to the “Verismo”, or realist, movement, and while in Naples he worked on history paintings. In Rome he decorated public and private buildings with historical and allegorical themes, pagan rituals and scenes from the Greek and Roman tradition, highly valued by the international market. *The Temple of Venus* is an archeological reconstruction of a sacred interior showing an offering to the goddess Venus for the beginning of Spring. The painting is part of the group of works by the artist presented at the Exposition in Milan in 1871, Nice in 1884 and London in 1888.

en.name: Coronation of His Majesty King Charles X, in Rheims,  29 May 1825
short_description: Charles X was Louis XVI's younger brother. During the revolution, Charles (then the Count of Artois) emigrated in search of support from other European royal courts. He disapproved of Louis XVIII's pragmatism, and following his death advocated a return to the Ancien Régime. He had himself crowned in Reims, like his ancestors, although the cost of this grandiose ceremony was the subject of great controversy.
keywords: Monarchy

fr.name: *Sacre de sa Majesté Charles X, à Rheims le 29 mai 1825*
short_description: Charles X est le frère cadet de Louis XVI. Lors de la Révolution française, Charles (comte d'Artois) a émigré et cherché des appuis auprès des cours d'Europe. Il désapprouve la politique de conciliation de Louis XVIII, et à la mort de ce dernier, prône un retour à l'Ancien Régime. Il se fait donc sacrer à Reims comme ses ancêtres. La cérémonie, très dispendieuse, surprend l'opinion.
keywords: Monarchie

ar.name: مصباح زيت
description: المصابيح الزيتية من هذا النوع يعتقد عموما بأنها من بداية العصر الإسلامي وهذه القطعة لها جسم ضحل صغير والذي يملك إطار مبرز بشكل طفيف. وإن ميزابها بشكل راقدة ذات فلنجات مستديرة من الطرفين. والمقبض مصنوع من حلقة التي يفترض أنها مسند للإبهام ثلاثي الفصوص. ولكن هذا المقبض مكسور بحيث أن الحجم الأصلي بالكاد يمكن تقديره. وعلى طرف الجسم أيضا يوجد فلنجتين صغيرتين ثلاثيتي الفصوص بالرغم من أن التي في الطرف الأيسر رأسها مكسور. والمقبض والفلنجات تظهر ثقوب حفر مدورة وبعيدا عن ذلك فإن القطعة لا تتميز بأي تزيين وتظهر غير مزخرفة تقريبا ككل . والقاعدة مسطحة ولا تتميز بقدم . وتظهر شبها وثيقا بالقطعة من خراسان أو أفغانستان المعروضة من قبل Eva Baer. وقد أظهرت أن شكل الجسم مستمد من القطع السابقة البيزنطية والمصباح الآخر من ميمنة في أفغانستان هو مثال عن التكيف الإسلامي مع تغيير طفيف حيث أن الميزاب الآن مثلثي ومتصل بدلا من كونه بارز لخارج الجسم. وقطعة بوميلر تظهر ثانية تعديلا طفيفا حيث أن الميزاب هنا بشكل راقدة ويندمج مع قاعدة المصباح.
keywords: مشغولة معدنية ، مصباح زيت ، بداية العصر الإسلامي
tags: مشغولة معدنية ، مصباح زيت ، بداية العصر الإسلامي

en.name: Oil lamp
description:
Oil lamps of this type are generally thought to be early Islamic. This particular piece has a small, shallow body with a slightly emphasized rim. Its spout is keel-shaped with two small round flanges on the sides. The handle is made from a ring with presumably a three-lobed thumb rest. But this is broken off, so the original size and shape can merely be guessed. On the side of the body also two small three-lobed flanges are found, though on the left-sided one the tip is broken off. The handle and the flanges show small round drill holes. Apart from that, the object features no decoration and appears fairly unadorned on the whole. The base is flat and does not feature a foot.  
  
It shows close resemblance to an object from Khurasan or Afghanistan presented by Eva Baer. She shows that the shape of the body derives from Byzantine predecessors. The original spouts are of tubular shape. Another lamp from Maimana, Afghanistan is an example of an Islamic adaptation with a slight change, as the spout is now triangular and attached instead of growing out of the body. The Bumiller object does again show a slight modification as the spout here is keel-shaped and merged with the base of the lamp.
holder: University Museum of Islamic Art | The Bumiller Collection
keywords: Metalwork; oil lamp; early islamic
partner: University Museum of Islamic Art | The Bumiller Collection

en.name: Clogs
description: *Nanule* (Tr. *nalın*) – clogs from the Museum of Applied Art in Belgrade (a.n. TC-283 (1942)), are made of wood. They have a slightly flared front wedge and a concave back wedge. The toe of the sole is square, and the heel is round. The sole is decorated with intarsia of leaf-shaped medallions with carved vegetal motifs, while along the edges runs a frame of inlaid mother-of-pearl rhombi. The wedges are adorned with carved geometrical motifs. The leather straps that hold the clog on the foot are plain. The clogs were used in the hamam, and belong to the shared dress and living culture of the urban population in the Ottoman Balkans, which had diverse confessional and ethnic backgrounds.

materials: Wood, mother-of-pearl, leather; inlay, intarsia, carving

ar.name: قطعة نقدية (درهم).
description: قطعة نقدية فضية هي درهم، تزن 2.74 غ، وسكت في سيواس في تركيا باسم قلج أرسلان الرابع (تقريباً 646-54/ 1248-57). كتب على الوجه الأول اسم الحاكم السلطان الأعظم ركن الدنيا والدين قلج ارسلان بن كيخسرو قسيم أمير المؤمنين. تحيط هذه الكتابة برامي سهام يعتلي صهوة جواد، شبيه بالنسخة المغولية من خان أولوش بيك العظيم (642-3/ 1244-45). كان السلاجقة يدفعون جزية سنوية لملوكهم الإسميين من المغول. وعلى الوجه الآخر للقطعة النقدية كتب اسم الخليفة المعتصم آخر الخلفاء العباسيين في بغداد. يعتبر هذا النقد مثالاً استثنائياً للنقد الإسلامي لأن الزخرفة التصويرية على القطع النقدية كانت نادرة في العالم الإسلامي.

درهم من الفضة، يظهر عليه نقش نافر باسم "ركن الدنيا والدين قلج أرسلان الرابع"، الذي حكم سلاجقة الأناضول (عام 646 هـ/ 1248- 1257 م). يبرز على الدرهم زخرفة على شكل فارس يمتطي جواده، وقد استُوحي هذا النوع من الزخارف من الطراز المنغولي الأصلي.
keywords: رمي سهام؛ فروسية؛ عملة؛ علم العملة

en.name: Coin (*dirham*).
description: A silver *dirham* coin, weighing 2.74g, struck at Sivas in Turkey in the name of Qilij Arslan IV (Kılıç Arslan IV, r. AH 646–54 / AD 1248–57). On the obverse is the ruler's name: 'The very great Sultan Izz al-Dunya wa'l-Din Qilij Arslan son of Kaykhusraw Companion of the Commander of the Faithful'. This inscription surrounds a depiction of a mounted archer, similar to a Mongol issue of the Great Khan Ulush Beg (AH 642–3 / AD 1244–5). The Seljuqs paid an annual tribute to their nominal overlords the Mongols. On the reverse of the coin, is the caliph's name, inscribed: al-Musta'sim, the last of the Abbasid caliphs in Baghdad. This is an unusual example of an Islamic coin, given that figurative representation on coins was relatively rare in the Islamic world.

This silver *dirham* bears the name of Rukn al-Dunya wa’l-Din, Qilij Arslan IV, who ruled Seljuq Anatolia from AH 646 to 654 / AD 1248–57. Its design of a horse and rider is rare and is derived from a Mongol prototype.
keywords: horsemanship; archery; coin; coinage; numismatics

es.name: Dirham
description: Dirham de plata de 2,74 g de peso, acuñado en Sivas (Turquía) en nombre de Qilij Arslan IV (r. 646–654 / 1248–1257), mencionado en el anverso: “El grandísimo sultán Izz al-Dunya wa al-Din Qiliy Arslan hijo de Kayjusrau, compañero del comandante de los fieles”. La inscripción rodea la representación de un arquero a caballo, como en una moneda mongola del gran jan Ulush Beg (642–43 / 1244–45). Los selyuquíes pagaban un tributo anual a sus señores nominales, los mongoles. En el reverso de la moneda aparece inscrito el nombre del califa: al-Mustasim, el último califa abbasí de Bagdad. Este es un ejemplo inusual dentro de las monedas islámicas por la presencia de decoración figurativa.

Dirham de plata con el nombre de Rukn al-Dunya wa al-Din, Qiliy Arslan IV, quien gobernó en la Anatolia selyuquí en los años 646-654  / 1248–1257. La representación de un arquero a caballo no es habitual y deriva de un modelo mongol.
keywords: equitación; tiro con arco; moneda; numismática

fr.name: Pièce de monnaie.
description: Pièce d'argent, ou *dirham,* de 2,74 g frappée à Sivas en Turquie au nom de Qilij Arslan IV (r. de 646 à 654 H / 1248 à 1257 J.-C.). À l'avers figure le nom du souverain : “Le très éminent sultan Iss al-Dunya wa'l-Din Qilij Arslan, fils de Kaykhusrau, Compagnon du Commandeur de la Foi.” Cette inscription entoure un archer monté, similaire à une version mongole du Grand Khan Ulugh Beg (642-643 H / 1244-1245 J.-C.). Les Seldjoukides versaient un tribut annuel à leurs suzerains nominaux les Mongols. Au revers est inscrit le nom du calife al-Moustasim, dernier des califes abbassides régnant à Bagdad. Cette pièce est d'un modèle peu courant en pays islamique, puisque les représentations figuratives sur les monnaies y étaient relativement rares.

Le *dirham* porte le nom de Rukn al-Dunya wa'l-Din, Qilij Arslan IV, qui gouverna l'Anatolie seldjoukide de 646 à 654 H / 1248-1257 J.-C. Son motif, cheval et cavalier, est rare et dérive d'un prototype mongol.
keywords: Équitation ; cavalerie ; archerie; monnaie; numismatique

pt.name: Cabeceira da capela-mor
description: A cabeceira é um corpo com um efeito urbano típicamente barroco, em que o efeito-surpresa contou no projecto, impondo-se subitamente para quem caminha no dédalo de ruas que rodeiam a catedral. A sua escala rompe com a própria malha urbana, acentuando o efeito-surpresa de autêntico espectáculo arquitectónico, ponderado mas festivo, do urbanismo barroco.

en.name: *Natürmort*
short_description: The foundation of Turkish painting drawing influence from western tradition was laid when the Naval Academy opened in 1795. In the period of Selim II, painting lessons were given at the academy. And course attendees were sent abroad after to develop their painting techniques and skills. These painters, who were known as the soldier-painters, worked in Gerome’s, Cabanel’s and Boulanger’s workshops in Paris. Halil Paşa provided a unique distinction to the analysis of impressionist light and colour. Because of his qualified knowledge about anatomy and his interest in depicting the human figure, Halil Paşa has a unique place in Turkish Art History.
holder: Mimar Sinan Fine Arts University, Painting and Sculpture Museum
keywords: Painting; Halil Paşa; orientalist Turkish painters; still life
partner: Ministry of Culture and Tourism (General Directorate for Cultural Heritage and Museums)

description: تاج العمود هذا أتى من قصر المدينة الرائعة مدينة الزهراء والتي أسسها الخليفة الأموي عبد الرحمن الثالث في عام 936 قرب قرطبة. وهي مكونة من أبنية إدارية وقاعات استقبال وأحياء سكنية وساحات  وسرادقات ومساجد وأسواق وإن عمارتها تتميز بشكل صفوف متتالية من الأقواس على هيئة حدوة حصان على أعمدة رفيعة ذات تيجان منحوتة ومثقوبة مثل هذا المبين هنا وهي شكل تجريدي للأشكال المدبجة  الكلاسيكية والحدبة من أحد طرفي هذا التاج تحمل نقش "" صنع من قبل خبارا؟""

en.name: Capital
description: This capital probably came from the splendid palace city of Madinat al-Zahra, which the Umayyad caliph ‘Abd al Rahman III founded in 936 near Córdoba. Consisting of administrative buildings, reception halls, residential quarters, courtyards, pavilions, mosques, and markets, its architecture featured row after row of horse shoe arches on slender columns with exquisitely carved and drilled capitals such as this one, abstracted from classical Corinthian forms. A boss at one side of this capital bears the inscription “Made by Khabara[?]”.
keywords: Umayyad of Cordoba; Cordoba; Spain; capital; acanthus; acanthus leaves; architectural decoration; architectural element; carved decoration; carving; column capital; corinthian; Madinat al-Zahra; marble; plant decoration; vegetal decoration

en.name: Church of San Francisco
description:
The convent of San Francisco was founded by the boshop don Tello Téllez de Meneses whose tomb in polychromed wood can be seen under the splendid eight-sided wooden ceiling in the sacristy. The work commissioned at the beginning of the 16C by the bishop don Juan de Castilla in the upper choir in the nave is another notable achievement , but both take second place to the unique funeral chapel built for the Sarmiento family by a Mudéjar plasterer who we will often come across in the lands of Castilla and who here, curiously has signed his masterpiece “Alonso Martínez”.  
In the chapel there are various images. In a niche of gothic traceries , crests and transparencies the statue of the stout person buried there, possibly Juan Sarmiento, kneels in eternal prayer. There are other statues too, under small canopies whcih represent apostles or saints.

es.name: Iglesia de San Francisco
description: El convento de San Francisco fue fundado por el obispo don Tello Téllez de Meneses, cuya tumba de madera policromada se halla bajo la espléndida techumbre de ochavo de la sacristía. La intervención encargada a comienzos del siglo XVI por el obispo don Juan de Castilla en el coro alto de la nave es otro acierto notable, pero ambas palidecen frente a la singular capilla funeraria que levantó para la familia Sarmiento un yesero mudéjar que volveremos a encontrar a menudo en tierras castellanas y que, curiosamente, aquí firmó su obra: “Alonso Martines”. En la capilla hay varias imágenes. En un lucillo de calados góticos, cresterías y claraboyas, vela sin descanso la estatua orante de bulto redondo del personaje enterrado, posiblemente Juan Sarmiento. También hay otras estatuas, bajo doseletes, que representan a apóstoles o santos.

en.name: Research on the location of Carthage (with 15 illustrated pages)
short_description: Christian Théodore Falbe, captain of a Danish ship and explorer, was the Tunisian consul before becoming  delegate for the Société pour l'Exploration de Carthage. Fable dedicated himself to developing a new map of Tunis, which required the use of newly developed techniques. He had to use his cunning to be able to draw these plans, as he had aroused the suspicion of the Tunisian population, and ended up doing many of them from the roofs of neighbouring consulates. His pioneering work on Carthage should be seen as part of a greater international movement which had recently taken great interest in this destroyed and long-forgotten city.
keywords: archaeological excavations; Tunisia

fr.name: Recherches sur l'emplacement de Carthage (5 planches qui accompagnent l'ouvrage)
short_description: Christian Tuxen Falbe, capitaine de vaisseau danois, explorateur, a été consul à Tunis puis délégué de la Société pour l'exploration de Carthage. Falbe se lance dans un travail inédit de cartographie de Tunis, qui demande des techniques nouvelles. Il doit aussi user de ruse pour se livrer à des relevés qui éveillent la méfiance de la population tunisienne: plusieurs de ses relevés sont pris depuis les toits des consulats voisins. Son travail pionnier sur Carthage s'insère dans un grand mouvement de curiosité internationale pour cette cité détruite puis longtemps oubliée.
keywords: Fouilles archéologiques; Tunisie

cs.name: Merkurova kašna
description:
Římský bůh obchodu žehná prosperitě města na křížení dvou ulic. Je vyobrazen se třemi základními znaky, symbolizující jeho poslání: Na hlavě má petasus (klobouk jako ochranu proti dešti), ve zdvižené pravé ruce drží caduceus (berlu  
s dvojicí spletených hadů, znak posla), na nohou má talaria (okřídlené opánky umožňující mu rychlé překonávání vzdáleností). Merkur je vlastně řecký Hermés, průvodce duší zemřelých. Proto jsou na této kašně take tři chrliče vody ve tvaru hadovitých delfínů, kteří symbolizují tři řeky v podsvětí – Léthe, Styx a Acherón.
artist: Václav Render (1669 Olomouc – 1733 Olomouc) – Filip Sattler (1695 Wenns, Tyrolsko – 1738 Olomouc)

en.name: Mercury Fountain
description: Mercury, the Roman god of trade, blesses the town's prosperity at the intersection of two streets. He is depicted with three basic attributes symbolising his vocation: he is wearing a *petasus* (hat to keep off the rain), in his raised right hand he holds a caduceus (a sceptre with a pair of intertwined serpents; a messenger's emblem), and has *talaria* on his feet (winged sandals to enable speedy travel). Mercury was equivalent to the Greek god Hermes, guide to the souls of the dead. The fountain thus features three serpentine dolphin gargoyles, symbolising three underworld rivers, the Lethe, the Styx and the Acheron.
artist: Václav Render (1669–1733 Olomouc), Filip Sattler (1695 Wenns, Tyrol – 1738 Olomouc)

en.name: Mosque of al-Tunbugha al-Maridani
description:
Amir al-Tunbugha al-Maridani al-Saqi (cupbearer) was born around the year 719/1319. He was Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad’s son-in-law and one of his *amirs* and went on to govern Aleppo where he died at the age of 25.  
The similarities apparent between the layout of this mosque and the mosque of al-Nasir Muhammad in the Citadel are not surprising when we learn that the same court architect, master (*mu‘alim*) al-Suyufi, designed them. Nevertheless, it is precisely some of the differences that are most worth pointing out. The main entrance to the mosque of al-Tunbugha al-Maridani has a plain pointed arch and in the centre of the courtyard there stands an octagonal marble font covered by a wooden dome from Sultan Hassan’s Madrasa. A dome covers the *mihrab* stretching across two aisles, rather than three as in the sanctuary of the Mosque of al-Nasir Muhammad. Its dimensions are similar to those rising above *mihrabs* in Fatimid times and to that of the Mosque of Sultan Baybars – the first of the *Bahri* Mamluk Sultans. Though restored in 1905, the pendentives still possess their original wooden stalactites, below which a wooden band bears gilt inscriptions of Qur’anic verses on a blue background.  
The decoration inside the mosque is magnificent, displaying all the finery of the most outstanding decoration of the period, from stucco and marble panels inlaid with mother of pearl, to carved wood, windows and tiles. One of the most characteristic elements of the mosque is the splendid *mashrabiyya* screen; separating the prayer hall from the courtyard it is one of the oldest screens still preserved in Egypt.  
The minaret, too, is believed to be one of the oldest to use the bulbiform finial, a style that would later be used extensively throughout the Mamluk period.

es.name: Mezquita de al-Tunbuga al-Maridani
description:
El emir al-Tunbuga al-Maridani al-Saqi (“copero”), nacido hacia 719/1319, fue uno de los emires del sultán al-Nasir Muhammad, su yerno y posteriormente gobernador de Alepo, donde murió a los veinticinco años.  
La semejanza de la planta de su mezquita con la de al-Nasir Muhammad, en la Ciudadela, no es sorprendente, ya que ambas fueron trazadas por el mismo arquitecto de la corte, el maestro (*mu‘alim*) al-Suyufi. Sin embargo, se distinguen en algunos de sus elementos. El acceso de la mezquita de al-Tunbuga, marcado por un arco apuntado, está exento de mocárabes, y en el centro del patio hay una pila octogonal de mármol, cubierta por una cúpula de madera procedente de la *madrasa* del sultán Hasan. Ya en la sala de la *qibla* se puede observar que la cúpula frente al *mihrab* abarca el ancho de dos naves, en vez de las tres que hay en la de al-Nasir Muhammad. Se trata de una cúpula de dimensiones similares a las que se levantaban sobre los *mihrab*s en la época fatimí y a las de la mezquita del sultán Baybars, el primero de los sultanes mamelucos *bahri*es. Aunque fue restaurada en 1905, todavía las pechinas conservan hileras de mocárabes de madera, bajo las cuales, en una banda de madera con inscripciones doradas sobre fondo azul, hay aleyas coránicas.  
La ornamentación interior de la mezquita es especialmente espléndida y exhibe la mayor parte del repertorio decorativo contemporáneo, como lienzos de mármol con incrustaciones de nácar, estuco y madera tallados, y ventanas con azulejos. Uno de los elementos más característicos de esta mezquita es la espléndida celosía de *machrabiyya* que separa la sala de oración del patio, una de las más antiguas que se conserva en Egipto.  
El alminar de la mezquita de al-Tunbuga al-Maridani se considera el más antiguo de los alminares cuyo remate adopta la forma de florón bulbiforme, que luego se extendió como una de las características de la época mameluca.

fr.name: Mosquée de al-Tunbugha al-Maridani
description:
L’émir al-Tunbugha al-Maridani al-Saqi (échanson), né vers 719/1319, fut l’un des émirs du sultan al-Nasir Muhammad, son gendre et futur gouverneur d’Alep où il mourut à l’âge de vingt-cinq ans.  
La parenté de plan entre sa mosquée et celle de al-Nasir Muhammad dans la Citadelle n’est pas pour surprendre puisque toutes deux sont l’oeuvre du même architecte de la cour, le maître (*mu‘alim*) al- Suyufi. Quelques éléments les différencient cependant. L’accès de la mosquée de al-Tunbugha, encadré par un arc brisé, est dépourvu de *mouqarna*s, et le centre de la cour est agrémenté d’un bassin octogonal en marbre couvert d’une coupole en bois provenant de la *madrasa* du sultan Hassan. Et dans la salle de la *qibla*, on peut observer que la coupole face au *mihrab* couvre la largeur de deux nefs, au lieu de trois dans celle de al-Nasir Muhammad. Il s’agit d’une coupole de dimensions similaires à celles qui surmontent les *mihrab*s de l’époque fatimide et à celle de la mosquée du sultan Baybars, le premier des sultans mamelouks *bahrides*. Bien qu’elle ait été restaurée en 1905, les pendentifs conservent encore leurs encorbellements de *mouqarnas* de bois sous lesquels un bandeau épigraphique en bois porte des inscriptions dorées sur fond bleu reprenant des versets coraniques.  
L’ornementation intérieure de la mosquée est particulièrement splendide et affiche la plus grande partie du répertoire décoratif de l’époque, comme les entrelacs de marbre à incrustations de nacre, les stucs et les bois sculptés, et les fenêtres à azulejos. Un des éléments les plus caractéristiques de cette mosquée est la superbe jalousie de *machrabiyya* qui sépare la salle de prière de la cour, une des plus anciennes qui soient conservées en Égypte. Le minaret de la mosquée de al-Tunbugha al-Maridani est tenu pour le plus ancien des minarets à couronnement bulbeux, formule qui fut diffusée comme l’une des caractéristiques de l’époque mamelouke.

ar.name: أوان للغسيل، إبريق وحوض.
description:
يقدم الإبريق والحوض عادةً في البلاط لغسل اليدين على المائدة، وتصف مصادر القرون الوسطى العربية الأواني من هذا النوع. وقد كانت هذه الأواني تعتبر قطعا من تجهيزات بنات الأمراء والوزراء وعلية القوم والموظفين الكبار والتجار. وبناء على المناظر التي تحتوي على رسوم أيقونات على هذه الأواني الموجودة الآن في برلين، فإن من المرجح أنها صنعت لرجل قضاء، فالكتابات الموجودة عليها عبارة عن أمان بالبركة والتوفيق ( العز والبقاء والبر والعطاء والجود والسخاء والمجد والنماء والنور والصفاء والصبر والرضا والحلم والحياء والدهر والوفاء والنصر على الأعداء لصاحبه أبدا) لصاحبها المجهول. ولا تزال الروعة الأساسية واضحة للعيان بسبب شروط حفظها الجيدة.  
شكل الإبريق بغطائه ذي المفصلة وبمصبه المستقيم يوضح الانطباع المجسم. أما وسط الإبريق وكتفاه وعنقه فهي مزدانة بثلاثة أفاريز عليها مناظر وأشكال على نقوش بارزة كبيرة. وهذه النقوش مملوءة برسوم عروش وخيالة وصور الكواكب. أما أصل العنق فعليه أحد عشر حقلا مقوسا لأشخاص في وضع الوقوف وعلى شكل الرسوم المسيحية. وهناك شكل في إفريز من الحيوانات على طرف الكتف يبين عملية اصطياد لوحيد القرن. بالإضافة إلى ذلك توجد كتابات عربية موزعة في الأفاريز أو فوق الإبريق تتضمن الأماني الطيبة (العز والبقاء والشكر والثناء أبدا).  
توجد على قعر الحوض ستة رسوم لكواكب حول الشمس، وفي إفريز آخر تبدو صور برج سماوي مع بعض الكواكب. وكما هي الحال على الإبريق، فإن الحوض يزدان بستة نقوش بارزة كبيرة على الجانب الخارجي تمثل الأمير محاطا بحراسه كما تظهر بعض مشاهد الصيد والأشخاص الذين يحتفلون ويشيرون إلى وليمة. وترتبط هذه النقوش بكتابة تعبر عن الأماني بالعز والنصر والعلم والحلم.  
ويشير تعقيد التصميم والنوعية الرفيعة في التنفيذ إلى سمو مكانة من صنعت هذه الأواني لأجله. كذلك فإن التوقيع بالاسم على الإبريق والحوض يؤكد أيضا القيمة العالية للفنان المنفذ.

إن التصميم والمهارة فائقي الروعة والإتقان لهذين الطست والإبريق، يُسلِّطان الضوء على مهارة صناعة المعادن في الموصل نحو 1270م. ربما كان هذا الطقم المُنفَّذ تلبيةً لأمر مسؤول كبير، والمُزيَّن بحشد من رسوم النباتات، ومشاهد حياة البلاط، يُوضع قيد الاستخدام لغسل الأيدي في مناسبات خاصة.
